You and I are well aware that there's a lot at stake in this election — too much to keep track of. We call the candidates in these races our Democracy Defenders , because, if elected, they will be key firewalls against Republicans’ anti-democracy efforts across the country. These candidates are running for a variety of roles: governor, state legislator, supreme court justice, and more. body:

Peter,
I’m about to ask you to **[chip in $10 to support my re-election here in Maryland.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260817-3.Ys0N01&refcode=em-20260817-3&t=2&akid=1768%2E1086043%2E9cXKpp)** But first, let me tell you why.
Our campaign's next deadline is quickly approaching, and after tomorrow night, everyone will be watching our fundraising numbers.
National Republicans are looking for any sign that our campaign is vulnerable. They want to flood this race with money, flip Maryland red, and roll back our progress.
I want our fundraising report to send a clear message: _**Maryland is not for sale to the highest bidder.**_
**[This campaign depends on grassroots supporters like you chipping in what they can a few dollars at a time. body:
What is happening to America?
What is happening to America?

| | | | Fellow American, What in the world is happening to America? There was a time when Zohran Mamdani's radical ideas were making daily headlines: **_State-run grocery stores_**** _Tax the middle class out of the city_**** _ Calling for replacing police officers with social workers_**** ** Red-blooded Americans will look at that list with utter disgust. ** ** Abdul El-Sayed, on the other hand, saw everything Mamdani did, and decided to say... _ "Hold my beer." _ El-Sayed is making Mamdani look like child's play: **_Endorsed by the Muslim Brotherhood_** **_Publicly defended Sharia Law_**** _Wants a system of "public control" of companies (also known as _communism_)_****_Ban 4th of July fireworks and football_**** _ _** And now, we have James Talarico here in Texas of all places who rails against God, Christianity, free market capitalism, and the Constitution. 10 years ago, someone with these views would never have stood a chance - let alone in _Texas!_ But not today... **There is a real possibility that El-Sayed and Talarico will serve in the Senate - and they'll have SIX YEARS to do irreparable damage to our country.** The _America_ you and I know and love is on the ballot this November. Every value we hold is on the chopping block in the midterm elections. **We 're in the final stretch of the election - and our GOP candidates really need your help overcoming massive fundraising deficits.**** ** **If you can, will you please split a contribution that will automatically provide critical last-minute resources to Ken Paxton and Mike Rogers - who are running to defeat Talarico and El-Sayed? body:
Judicial Watch announced that it filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Justice for the contents of Anthony Fauci’s government-issued cell phones. The phones were provided to former National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Diseases (NIAID) Director Fauci and later reportedly recovered by the FBI (Judicial Watch v. U.S. Department of Justice (No. 1:26-cv-02812)).

Dear Peter, The choices we make today shape the Oregon future generations will inherit. As someone who has already invested in protecting Oregon's environment, you've helped safeguard the forests, wildlife, clean air and water, and healthy communities that make this state so special. This **Make a Will Month** , I invite you to consider one more way to ensure that legacy continues for generations to come. Whether it's a favorite hiking trail, a quiet stretch of coastline, or the forests and rivers that make Oregon home, the places we love connect us across generations. A planned gift helps ensure that future generations inherit the same natural beauty—and that there will always be advocates fighting to protect Oregon's environment and climate.

[**Make the pledge to include OLCV or OLCV Education Fund in your will or estate plan.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137420485/640749132/1838085064?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImQ2MjM2NjI0LWEwOWEtZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMGQzYTExZmEzMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=lD0P5n8Xm2joSaO-LYYoDubcQs6DLRGLlHy-jZfzWFY=&emci=0b5b556c-8d9a-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&emdi=d6236624-a09a-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ceid=2107230) A legacy gift is one of the most powerful ways you can invest in Oregon's future. Your generosity will help ensure there are champions fighting for clean air and water, climate action, and leaders who will protect our environment for years to come. **For many supporters, a legacy gift is a way to ensure the values that have guided their lives continue to make a difference for generations to come.** There are many ways to make a planned gift and it can be simpler than you think. You can include OLCV or the OLCV Education Fund in your will or revocable trust, or name us as a beneficiary of a retirement account, life insurance policy, bank or brokerage account, certificate of deposit, or donor advised fund. If you have questions about legacy giving or would simply like to talk through your options, I'd be happy to help, but please always contact your lawyer or financial advisor to guide you through this process. If you've already included OLCV in your estate plans—or if you plan to—we'd love to hear from you. Letting us know allows us to thank you, honor your wishes, and better plan for the future.

Science, Not BS

---
| | | **[Demand Trump Rescind"Insane" Vaccine Order](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8d84fe9f-d971-4a48-b71e-d0c4c035cc4f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** Donald Trump and RFK Jr. spent years [pushing anti-vaccine BS](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td4f12bb4-d0e0-48b3-bd4c-80315c2bc2eb/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9). And a lot of people believed them, didn’t get vaccinated, and helped bring back some horrors we’d just about wiped out. (Welcome back measles!) [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb79065ba-5d4e-4943-abfb-4bfd9bce11a2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) But now these jackasses have made things even worse. Trump has signed an executive order bringing this anti-vaccine nonsense directly into federal vaccine policy -- and forcing steps that morons support, but actual scientists and epidemiologists do not, including splitting up the MMR vaccine and reducing the number of universally recommended vaccines. **Meaning more kids could get sick—and some could die from preventable diseases.** [**Add your name: Demand that Trump rescind his insane vaccine order.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T30fa4da2-7b7d-445b-b444-311c1cccebee/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) And now even a Republican senator who is also a doctor has finally found his balls and is sounding the alarm. **Sen. Bill Cassidy called Trump’s approach “a stupid thing to do,” said there is “no evidence whatsoever” that vaccines cause autism, and warned that forcing families into more shots and more doctor visits could mean fewer children get fully vaccinated.** When even batshit-insane (or cowardly) Republicans think Trump is going too far, you know there’s a there there. [**Add your name: Demand that Trump rescind his insane vaccine order.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tcfa405b4-09bb-4281-8a2f-4cbefa4fb4c7/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

body:
WE NEED TO GET OUR MESSAGE IN FRONT OF MORE VOTERS.

| | | | | |
---
| | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/2TGW70RuZvX?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
| | Hello Peter,

Dr. Enoch’s campaign is moving across Ohio’s 8th Congressional District — **knocking doors, meeting voters, attending community events, organizing volunteers, and building the grassroots operation we need to compete.** Now we need your help with the next critical phase:

# WE NEED TO GET OUR MESSAGE IN FRONT OF MORE VOTERS.
With Election Day getting closer, we need to dramatically increase our visibility across the district. That means investing in **large campaign signs in high-traffic locations and digital advertising that reaches voters where they spend their time online.** And we need the resources to do it.
## CAN YOU HELP US FUND THE NEXT PHASE OF THIS CAMPAIGN?
Every contribution helps us communicate with more voters.A contribution can help us:
* Purchase **large-format campaign signs** for high-visibility locations throughout OH-8
* Expand our **digital advertising** to reach targeted voters across the district
* Produce and distribute campaign literature
* Support canvassing, phone banking and voter outreach
* Promote upcoming events and opportunities for voters to meet Dr. Enoch

**We cannot afford to be invisible.**
Our opponent has the advantages of incumbency, name recognition, and an established fundraising network. We are building something different: **a grassroots campaign powered by people who believe Ohio's 8th Congressional District deserves better representation.**

### [Will you invest $25, $50, $100, $250 — or whatever you can afford — to help us get our message out?](https://us.list-manage.com/1CKpvpszjq8?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)

**DONATE TODAY:**
[ https://enochforcongress.com/donate-now/](https://us.list-manage.com/18ryuRT_Foc?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)If you've already contributed, **thank you.** Your support is helping keep this campaign moving.
And if you can give again, this is an important time to do it.
* * *

[](https://us.list-manage.com/szsGkcXfbz3?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
# YARD SIGNS ARE IN!

We've heard from supporters across the district who want to show their support — and **our Vanessa Enoch for Congress yard signs have arrived!**
Putting a sign in your yard may seem like a small thing, but visibility matters.A yard sign tells your neighbors:
**There is a campaign happening. There is an alternative. There is a choice.**
### Request your FREE yard sign here:

[https://enochforcongress.com/product/free-yard-sign/](https://us.list-manage.com/IpDQe_wgapy?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
After you request yours, encourage a neighbor, friend or family member in the district to request one too.
**Let's make support for this campaign visible throughout OH-8.**
* * *
[****](https://us.list-manage.com/oKl7VClDNEB?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
# COME MEET DR. ENOCH
We also have several opportunities coming up to meet Dr. Vanessa Enoch, talk about the issues, and get involved in the campaign.
## FROM CONVERSATION TO CONGRESS
### Meet & Greet Reception
**Tuesday, August 25, 2026**
**6:30 PM – 8:00 PM****Hummus & Pita**
7334 Tylers Corner Dr.
West Chester, OH 45069This is an opportunity for real conversation about the issues affecting our families and communities — and the solutions we need from Washington.**Real Conversations. Real Solutions. Real Impact.****RSVP:**
[https://campaignhq.app/rsvp/hummusandpita](https://us.list-manage.com/__5U_E4CC0I?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
* * *
[****](https://us.list-manage.com/nFjhcP1o6Pq?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
## MEET THE CANDIDATE
### Major Minor Books and Such
**Thursday, August 27**
**7:00 PM – 8:30 PM**
_Doors open at 6:45 PM_**Major Minor Books and Such**
6718 Montgomery Rd.
Cincinnati, OH 45236
Come meet Dr. Enoch and hear about her priorities for Ohio's 8th Congressional District, including protecting Social Security and Medicare, lowering healthcare and prescription drug costs, strengthening veterans' services, creating jobs, expanding affordable housing, investing in American manufacturing, and holding government accountable.
Bring your questions — and bring a friend. [RSVP here](https://us.list-manage.com/av8yFIBuEn3?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8).
* * *
[](https://us.list-manage.com/6Ni5aNdBM0W?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
## CANVASS GREENHILLS WITH US!
### Canvass for Jonathan Bradner & Dr. Vanessa Enoch
**Sunday, August 30**
**2:00 PM – 5:00 PM****Drummond St. & Damon Rd.**
99 Drummond Street
Greenhills, Ohio
The Cincinnati Working Families Party Wolf Pack is organizing a [canvass covering **Greenhills A, B and C. RSVP on Mobilize here.**](https://us.list-manage.com/12tQnzElVng?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
No canvassing experience is necessary. **Training will be provided.**
Bring a fully charged phone, comfortable walking shoes, and a friend.
* * *
# WE HAVE A LOT OF WORK TO DO — AND NOT A LOT OF TIME.
This campaign is growing.People are volunteering.People are requesting signs.People are attending events.People are knocking doors.And voters are beginning to hear our message.
**Now we need to scale.**
That requires resources.When you contribute to this campaign, you aren't simply making a donation. **You're helping us communicate with voters who may otherwise never hear about this race.**
You're helping us put up the signs.You're helping us run the ads.You're helping us print the literature.You're helping us knock the doors.You're helping us build the field operation.And ultimately, **you're helping give voters in Ohio's 8th Congressional District a real choice.**

### Please make a contribution today.

**DONATE:**
[ https://enochforcongress.com/donate-now/](https://us.list-manage.com/YaRBG8ySTKT?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
**REQUEST A YARD SIGN:**
[ https://enochforcongress.com/product/free-yard-sign/](https://us.list-manage.com/CrkhbKe6gRs?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
**VOLUNTEER:**
[ https://campaignhq.app](https://us.list-manage.com/W0fTNOf7MZs?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
[Whether you can give **$10, $25, $50, $100, $250 or more** , your contribution moves us closer to the resources we need to compete.](https://us.list-manage.com/s0mE9j3fWir?e=c6e7dff14c&c2id=d95570268fc9105c688a303b4f3b91b8)
**We can do this — but we have to do it together.** Thank you for believing in this campaign and in what we are working to build for Ohio's 8th Congressional District.
**Dr. Vanessa Enoch**
Democratic Nominee for Congress
Ohio's 8th Congressional District
**Enough of Excuses. It's Time for Results.****Real Leadership. Real Solutions. A Stronger Ohio.**
_Paid for by the Committee to Elect Enoch, Catherine Johnson, Treasurer._

| | | | | | It feels like nobody is running for governor right now.
Mark's hearing that [Deb Haaland's people think they're up double digits](https://us.list-manage.com/9ylN6KOub7u?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e), and from what we can tell they're acting like it. In other news, credit card delinquencies are also back where they were during the Great Recession, which matters because every midterm comes down to the economy.
---

---](https://us.list-manage.com/DlhlgBQVRGa?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | 🏛️ **HAALAND'S CAMP THINKS THEY'RE UP DOUBLE DIGITS**
Mark has been saying for weeks that a quiet race is bad news, and this one has been very quiet.
He goes through what he's hearing about the mood inside her operation, the poll she sent out to thousands of donors, and why that poll probably raised her more money than it cost her.
Gregg Hull has Sandoval County. He's running out of time to introduce himself to the other 32, and nothing about this race gets louder on its own.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/1BNw2ySOgKi?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | 💰 **CREDIT CARD DELINQUENCIES ARE BACK AT GREAT RECESSION LEVELS**
The New York Fed's numbers landed Tuesday, and they're bad enough that both parties are already building 2026 campaigns around them.
Scott Jennings went on CNN with his version of how Republicans should handle it. Mark agrees with roughly half of that, and the half he doesn't is the part worth hearing.
Krysty takes it somewhere else. Her mother never carried a balance in her life, and Krysty's argument about why has almost nothing to do with Washington and everything to do with what you're holding in your hand when you pay.

📰 **THE JOURNAL HANDED THE SNAP STORY TO AN INTERN**
The tagline at the bottom says the writer is an intern with a statewide fellowship program, which is fine, except the Journal ran the piece with Stansbury and two food bank employees as the only voices in it.
Mark spent about three minutes looking and came up with six things missing from that article, including why people actually came off the rolls and a nine-figure bill that New Mexico taxpayers could end up covering. He's not blaming the intern, and he's pretty clear about who he thinks should have caught it.
🎓 **IT ISN'T THE PROFESSORS. WSJ EXPLAINS WHERE CAMPUS SOCIALISM STARTS**
Lazy rivers, buses with no fare, a dining hall where nothing has a price on it. Four years of that, then a $200,000 bill and a job market that works nothing like it.
Krysty read a good chunk of the Wall Street Journal piece out loud on the show, and there's a comparison in there about the dining hall, one kid with three plates of pasta and another with a salad, that lands a lot harder than it sounds like it should.

clean_body: Plus: Card delinquencies are back at Great Recession levels. | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com | | | | | | | | | | | | It feels like nobody is running for governor right now. Mark's hearing that , and from what we can tell they're acting like it. In other news, credit card delinquencies are also back where they were during the Great Recession, which matters because every midterm comes down to the economy. | | 🏛️ HAALAND'S CAMP THINKS THEY'RE UP DOUBLE DIGITS Mark has been saying for weeks that a quiet race is bad news, and this one has been very quiet. He goes through what he's hearing about the mood inside her operation, the poll she sent out to thousands of donors, and why that poll probably raised her more money than it cost her. Gregg Hull has Sandoval County. He's running out of time to introduce himself to the other 32, and nothing about this race gets louder on its own. | | | 💰 CREDIT CARD DELINQUENCIES ARE BACK AT GREAT RECESSION LEVELS The New York Fed's numbers landed Tuesday, and they're bad enough that both parties are already building 2026 campaigns around them. Scott Jennings went on CNN with his version of how Republicans should handle it. Mark agrees with roughly half of that, and the half he doesn't is the part worth hearing. Krysty takes it somewhere else. Her mother never carried a balance in her life, and Krysty's argument about why has almost nothing to do with Washington and everything to do with what you're holding in your hand when you pay. 📰 THE JOURNAL HANDED THE SNAP STORY TO AN INTERN The tagline at the bottom says the writer is an intern with a statewide fellowship program, which is fine, except the Journal ran the piece with Stansbury and two food bank employees as the only voices in it. Mark spent about three minutes looking and came up with six things missing from that article, including why people actually came off the rolls and a nine-figure bill that New Mexico taxpayers could end up covering. He's not blaming the intern, and he's pretty clear about who he thinks should have caught it. 🎓 IT ISN'T THE PROFESSORS. WSJ EXPLAINS WHERE CAMPUS SOCIALISM STARTS Lazy rivers, buses with no fare, a dining hall where nothing has a price on it. Four years of that, then a $200,000 bill and a job market that works nothing like it. Krysty read a good chunk of the Wall Street Journal piece out loud on the show, and there's a comparison in there about the dining hall, one kid with three plates of pasta and another with a salad, that lands a lot harder than it sounds like it should. | | | | ✅ LIKE on ✅ hit the bell ✅ FORWARD to anyone who thinks the grocery stores will just fail on their own ✅ at NoDoubtAboutItPodcast.com | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | © 2026 Choose Adventure Media. A toss-up. In Louisiana. In a race that could decide the control of the U.S. Senate.
It might be shocking to the media and pundits, but to us it's no surprise. Since the Supreme Court gutted the Voting Rights Act, and MAGA Governor Jeff Landry canceled our congressional elections to ram through a gerrymandered map that eliminated one of our majority-Black districts, a backlash has been building.
The people of Louisiana see MAGA, with full control of the state and federal government, running our state into the ground. Runaway inflation. More foreign wars. An economy on the brink of collapse. And instead of earning votes at the polls, MAGA is trying to secure their reign through an authoritarian power grab.
The people of Louisiana are pissed off. And they're making their voices heard.
Louisiana Democrats have been on the ground, meeting with voters face to face and turning their frustration into action. Last month we launched our No More Silence: Road to the Polls, an 18-city tour to register voters, recruit No Party voters, and make sure every Louisianian knows how, when, and where to vote. Everywhere we went, rooms were packed with voters ready to vote Blue this November.

There are just 78 days until the November 3rd election and we need to reach millions more Louisianans before election day. We need your help to make that happen.
The Louisiana Democratic Party is among the least funded Democratic parties in the nation. To flip Louisiana blue we need your support. ### Ten Dollar Tuesday!

It's that time of week again- our signature day for fundraising! [**Will you help us reach our Ten Dollar Tuesday goal with a $10, $50, or $100 donation today?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tuesvern?refcode=tdtask)
Vern continues to travel the state, and gas ain't cheap. Your donation of $100 covers a tank of gas for the truck-every full tank means that many more North Dakotans hearing Vern's message. Are you in?**[Will you get Vern’s back by chipping in $10, $50, or whatever you can give for this week’s Ten Dollar Tuesday?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tuesvern?refcode=tdtask)**

### Packed House for Legislative Committee Hearing
---
[|
---](http://www.thompson4nd.com/)
| | | | |

Vern’s notes from the Monday, August 17th meeting of the Legislative Management Committee:
Senator Tim Mathern introduced these two bills and a resolution.**Bill # 1:** Data Center Permit Moratorium (25.1452)**Bill #2:** NDA Ban (25.1425)**Item #3 (25.3122) Resolution:** encouraging legislative management to further study laws and regulations about data centers to bring these to the regular session.
Committee members asked about whether the NDA ban could be expanded to include all industrial projects and whether the NDA ban could instead be a moratorium until the AI and Data Center interim committee had a chance to research it (until June 30, 2027). Sen Mathern was open to these ideas.Senator Myrdal suggested that these data center bills are opportunistic politics. Sen Mathern replied "When the citizenry tells us they need something, it's our responsibility to do something about it... That's why we are elected."Check back soon for updates on whether the bills pass the committee, or go to the link in the comments for the livestream.
\- -

NDAs are coming to the special session (with an amendment)Representative Warrey, who is chairman of the AI and Data Center interim committee, worked with Sen Mathern on this amendment to the NDA ban:The bill will now be a "Moratorium on NDAs for all industrial projects through June 30, 2027"Rep. Warrey's reasoning is the interim committee will now have time to look into the matter of NDAs further.The amended bill was approved by the committee unanimously. Congratulations Tim Mathern and Rep Matt Heilman on this bipartisan "slam dunk"!Thank you to everyone who contacted their legislators over the weekend. You made a difference. **Call your legislators if you want to see this passed on Sept 2!!!

** \- -

The Legislative Management Committee failed to advance a moratorium for new data center development.
I'm sad that the Legislative Management Committee did not advance a proposal to have public debate on the merits of a moratorium for new data center development. If a vote were taken by the people of North Dakota today it would probably be 80% support a moratorium and 20% oppose a moratorium. The majority of the committee is out of touch with the people of North Dakota. A moratorium would have leveled the playing field for local elected officials, it would've promoted local control. It would've given communities time to do research, give and hear public testimony and pass ordinances that fit the goals of their communities.Sen. Desiree van Oosting (R) introduced a data center quarterly reports bill that did not get thru the committee either.

It's disappointing that the majority on the committee put the interests of the out of state multi billion dollar corporations ahead of the people of North Dakota. It's less then 80 days until the election, the people of North Dakota will be heard!

**
**

| | | | |

---

Together, we got this.

Sincerely,

Team Thompson

body:

| Friend,
---
| It was revealed that the U.S. Postal Service is moving forward with a plan to limit mail-in voting by only sending ballots to voters who are registered on a list approved by the federal government.
---
| **This is an unprecedented assault for free and fair elections.**
---
| [](https://zzejj9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001d6UEGqZasbzbcBT421QfhicyLCFEktd7cgxDmMjBU6A4sXF-Kd0hN4giS9YM3iaSh4bPYROCQQqw33e6nCO57lEh7uwedCcwBeaeIfgn52MYpU3kY3j3XspzsijwsH8-B2BAmGGoeZRGwLc5dL3xrEH9JsqZpAcFLR4zMLuPYfk1QZKojjfpOoDQ6s3IjIV7TVQHliDKCq9Vm-_QJRzUAIdgAdVSDgiYSD7QYivAA86DfxIz8c_7dEtUuyzExV48&c=vTggEvd63gzczLZEtHAlZ0pl5_RKcwjxZYGkjl2S4nZEQvbcTXG9oA==&ch=0L2MBGlXRzfJ2WZu9Aln73RTd-4dvL1Ic3pTo_fJsiR8eZZd9jC6HQ==)
---
| **This rule would effectively give the Trump admin control over who receives ballots and who doesn’t.**
---
| _We do not have to imagine how Trump uses this power._ Live in a heavily Democratic area? _No ballot._ Have a name that sounds Black or Hispanic? _No ballot._ They are not hiding what this is. **It is a purge designed to look like election administration.**
---
| _And that last part is particularly important._ If you’ve been following our work, you know that in the Constitution, states have the responsibility for how elections are administered, not the federal government. **This move by the USPS would give the Trump admin unprecedented power over elections and it is** _**cartoonishly**_**unconstitutional.**
---
| But legal challenges to this rule will likely make their way up to the Supreme Court. And that’s where it gets scary— _we have seen how this court has ruled lately._ They have exposed themselves as complete and total puppets for Trump and MAGA extremists, willing to reverse nearly a half-century of legal precedent to tilt elections in their favor.
---
| **This is exactly why Defend Our Courts exists.** We are fighting on two fronts: building a firewall of state Supreme Courts that can protect free and fair elections at the state level, and building the movement to reform a federal court that has made itself an arm of the Trump administration.
---
| [We need every Democrat who understands what is at stake to stand with us. South Korea opened the 11-day Ulchi Freedom Shield drills Monday as planned, and said it will keep coordinating with Washington on defense. About 28,500 American troops are stationed in South Korea.

All ages are welcome, but you must be 21 or older to drink and IDs will be checked at the bar. Come spend Election Day with us, make calls, knock doors, connect with voters, and then join us that evening as we watch the results together.

name: Amy Carnevale
subject: 13 Reasons Why Massachusetts Needs a New Governor
body:
13 reasons why we need a new governor
| | | | | [](https://qgzxgy5ab.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001CCEbgx0KR162H9tnvDpvamAXbmR3tYtG-OJ14JSBFePmZpOp89Pw5vzr0-5Qrn_E_qqe69MWDMutZol6cbNaNeWDl-oNMZ0XbZM-NX7oW-Qlwv_cbdpwaUEyFcJHaHCwnDUIu1S_z8ZPoAK5ICSNRQ==&c=pUeN7rp9cfcz0Xe1JTkisWJ1blpIvckftU9FsrNFCHb1yOD3frZJIA==&ch=__4H4uDQdrb0XVCnt4xH-VB5lApQEyhmKmuxspuMf0kQk2OoPRlgxg==)
---
| Dear Peter,
There are plenty of reasons Massachusetts needs a new governor.
Here are 13 of them:
1. Public safety. Healey-appointed Parole Board members have released convicted murderers and violent criminals, including the Memorial Drive shooter.
2. Energy costs. Massachusetts families are paying some of the highest electricity rates in the country while Healey piles on surcharges and fees.
3. Accountability. Healey has reportedly refused to cooperate with the State Auditor for more than 18 months.
4. Massachusetts is falling behind. Our tax competitiveness, cost of doing business, electricity rates, and business growth have all moved in the wrong direction.
5. Fraud. Healey has failed to adequately address widespread fraud involving SNAP, MassDOT, and Medicare.
6. Local services. Unrestricted local aid has fallen to its lowest share of the state budget in 20 years, while the state budget has grown by $10 billion.
7. Bad judgment. Healey backed Graham Platner before his controversial record became public. That didn't age well.
8. Healey's allies & priorities. Healey said nothing as Mayor Wu proposed cuts to veterans and firefighters while raising her own salary and adding patronage hires.
9. Empty offices. One in four Boston office spaces is now vacant, up from just 5% in 2019.
10. No record to run on. More than half of Massachusetts voters can't name a single Healey accomplishment after three and a half years in office.
11. Affordability. Housing and the cost of living have deteriorated so badly that 56% of residents are considering leaving Massachusetts.
12. Public health and safety. Healey has known about sewer bypass problems in Haverhill for years. Massachusetts deserves a governor who makes public safety a priority.
13. Questionable hires. From Phil Eng to Lamar Cook, Healey's administration has repeatedly raised serious questions about who gets hired and who gets rewarded.

And the frustrating part? These are just 13 reasons from the past six months.
Massachusetts doesn't need more excuses.
Massachusetts needs accountability, affordability, and new leadership. Massachusetts needs a new kind of governor.
That's why MassGOP is investing in smart, targeted tactics that actually help Republicans reach voters.
For just $13, MassGOP can reach 100s of Republican voters and encourage them to return their mail-in ballots.
That's your $13 doing real work to defeat Maura Healey.
Will you chip in $13 today and help MassGOP put smart tactics like this to work tonight?

_**It feels like I typed and re-typed this note close to 100 times before I knew just how I wanted to say this. **_

This isn't about Republicans versus Democrats anymore. I need you to understand that what we are facing is something deeper and more dangerous

name: Rudy Giuliani
subject: It all comes down to this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rudy Defense Trust
body:
Out of nowhere you crossed my mind!

Please read my trial update:
| Dear Friend,
---
I've spent a lot of time ever since I awoke from my coma reflecting on the big picture of what my trial in Arizona is really all about.
---
I thought back to all the despicable things the vengeful Democrats have done to me...
---
[](https://email.editor.goppresidential.com/c/eJyckTuu2zAQRVdDdTL4N12weIGgVC8x0rySoMiRTYAfgaRsZPeBAmUDae-dMziD-fo0nzbEkB8_bAL9KNtmajOh2xhdSdB8eede-jM0QzGVI1YjUca6Hl5guB285lZyKeUAmlzVFQuKsRqeGksmvQDM-UKExzd-E85Lwf1640qKdQj6WIgVUYRQjK8XIASI4IQuoNTCCOIYfOilXg6tCi14yD3YeHElDVE_e98aYh-IzojODdxe4fIOuYI_JhCd6-5_jx5WyA3GXvfWEZ0FXW_Wq2UhTBC30gNn896TcTZtNjwyYtOpRhGVR9MdYtP3n_f7-M_5LBL4sCfEJkg2xDNsZa8OEJt-fZlvZ-ZK7pA7YtP9Y6jab-8QY2jyijh-HOzfo_p_fOCl6Z8AAAD__8kXkUM)
__
---
_A dawn raid on my home.
Arresting me alongside President Trump as innocent men.
Freezing my bank accounts.
Seizing my assets.
Forcing me to the point of bankruptcy._
---
**And now, a vengeful Democrat Attorney General making me stand in a rigged trial for bogus state-level crimes, because she knows that not even the most powerful man on the face of the planet – President Trump – can save me with a _federal_ pardon in _state_ court.**
---
The lunatic Left's desire to DESTROY yours truly knows no bounds.
---
They even stripped me of my law licenses so I would have no means to defend myself, leading pundits in the media to label me a **“ _DEAD_ _MAN_ _WALKING_!”**
---
But what I've come to realize ever since I came so close to death was that the pursuit of truth, freedom, and justice are worth infinitely more than any earthly possession.
---
**They can strip me of all I'm worth – _all I'll ever be worth_ – but what I _REFUSE_ to surrender to the Democrats and their Deep State thugs is my LEGACY!**
---
And __that__ is what my final trial is truly all about, Friend.
---
**I'd rather lose everything than betray what I know to be true. I could never lie and say what I'm going through is a fair and honest process just to hang on to “earthly possessions.”**
---
"__For what shall it profit a man, if he shall gain the whole world, and lose his own soul?_ " (Mark 8:36)_
---
You see, this FINAL BATTLE for my freedom is about ensuring this injustice can _NEVER_ _AGAIN_ happen to another innocent patriot all for standing by what he knows to be right and true.
---
I pray to God that will be my legacy when we win this trial.
---
But now, as I fight with all I've got, I have only one place left to turn to help me reach the finish line and secure my freedom: _good and honest Americans like _YOU__.
---

Far-right groups are pouring millions into this race to defeat me. body:
This fight can’t wait until November

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2996%2E4032634%2Erv9mDM)
---
United and Delta donated a million dollars to Trump. Then he killed the rule requiring airlines to compensate you when they cancel your flight. TurboTax’s parent company donated a million dollars to Trump. And Trump ended free tax filing directly with the IRS. Toyota donated a million dollars to Trump. And what do you know? Trump canceled a CFPB order that would have refunded people who were overcharged. **Those aren’t coincidences. That sure looks like pay-to-play. Or put another way: corruption, plain and simple.** And it’s not going to stop on its own. First, we need to win in November to put an immediate check on Trump’s administration. And then, we need to hold him and his cronies accountable for breaking the law. Then we need to clean up the corruption in Washington to guarantee these kinds of corrupt deals can never happen again. Every day, Trump takes any opportunity he can to use the presidency to line his own pockets and his family’s, reward his billionaire buddies, and make life harder for working people. We need to call it out, yes, but we also need to actually stop this corruption. That’s what I’m focused on. [**If you’re able, will you pitch in $28 or any amount to help power our anti-corruption campaign? Every donation is another signal that the American people are demanding real change and calling for a country that works for everyone, not just the rich and powerful.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/3752?amount=28&t=8&akid=2996%2E4032634%2Erv9mDM)

## Election Night Watch Party
Tuesday, August 18th at 7 pm - Midnight!
After weeks of joint canvassing and organizing, Team Kinter and Central Florida supporters of Angie Nixon have worked side by side to knock doors, connect with voters, and build a people-powered movement. That partnership has been a huge source of support for both campaigns, which is why tonight's celebration is about celebrating Angie Nixon and her supporters just as much as Marialana Kinter. Angie will be celebrating Election Night in her hometown of Jacksonville, so we're inviting her Central Florida supporters to join us in Sanford. Wear your Angie Nixon campaign shirts and come celebrate with us! Guest speakers:
* Dr. Julie Kent, Florida N.O.W.
* Ramon Bonilla, Sunrise Movement
* Daria Laycock, FL Rising Seminole
* Guerdy Remy, Medicare for All Florida
* Alexander McCoy, Common Defense
* Adam Abutaa, Emgage USA
* Fellipe Fischer, FL Young SemDems
* Cierre Rodriguez, Seminole Progressives

We'll also have live music from Tawnee, Comfort and Closure, Foxlair, MIASMA, and DJ TAJ. Doors open at 6:30 PM.
Catering will be provided by Cocina Maya Mexican Grill & Mezcaleria, with vegetarian options available. We'll also have specialty Election Night cocktails, including the Kinter Crush and Nixon's Southern Smash. Non-alcoholic versions are available. Must be 21+ to drink and IDs will be checked.
Sanford Women's Club 309 S. Oak Ave Sanford, FL 32771
Come celebrate the volunteers, organizers, supporters, and communities who made this movement possible.

Dear Friend of Life, **It can cost the abortion industry as little as $5 to get in front of a woman searching online for abortion pills.** That should stop us in our tracks. Imagine a woman who has just discovered she is pregnant. She wasn’t expecting this. She may be worried about money, insurance, child care, or how she could possibly have this baby. She is frightened, overwhelmed, and looking for someone to tell her what to do next. So she reaches for her phone. Within moments, she can find an abortion provider ready to sell her pills that will end her pregnancy and the life of her baby—all without ever walking into an abortion facility. **But what if she found hope instead?** PreBorn! is a Christian ministry dedicated to saving babies from abortion and seeing lives transformed through the gospel of Jesus Christ. Our Network Clinics across America provide free ultrasounds to women facing unexpected pregnancies. When a mother has the opportunity to see her baby and hear the heartbeat, what once felt like an impossible situation can suddenly look very different. But the way women are making decisions about abortion has changed. **Approximately 70% of abortions now happen through abortion pills.** Today, we cannot simply wait and hope a frightened mother walks through the doors of a pregnancy clinic. If women are going online looking for abortion, **we have to reach them there—and we have to reach them first.** That is why PreBorn! is expanding our reach through our Virtual Care System. Through this innovative approach, we can reach women while they are looking online for answers and create an opportunity for them to connect with something profoundly different from the abortion industry: **A real person who cares about her and her baby.** A registered nurse can listen to what she is facing without judgment, answer her questions, provide pregnancy education, help identify the pressures influencing her decision, and connect her with a local PreBorn! Network Clinic where she can receive an ultrasound and continued support. And when welcomed, our nurses can pray with these women and offer them the eternal hope of Jesus Christ. Friend of Life, think about the difference. The abortion industry is prepared to meet a frightened woman online and sell her pills to end the life of her baby. [**PreBorn! wants to meet her with a compassionate human being who will slow down, listen to what she is facing, and help her discover another path forward with her baby.**](https://email.update.insidescooppolitics.org/c/eJyUkcGK3DAMQL9GuU1wZI_tHHJYGtJetmxLYY_BI3sT0SQ2tjP9_TIwC732-J7ggaT31_nV8cbH8t3tYeBSZh_9vIYtnSUHR-sa8gfnUmcUqC_CXjo7O6p8D7NyjR-u2NkP24ShM9aIq9K6b9ah764dea-FUCQ6ZQWiUXQTvXDeCmsaHh49YTvboVBoWq-vymij-97ftDYESpzJuxpaPgr7UCjGlOLGlam0MS_NNqy1pgLyBXACnBa-87G0KYdbzEdLcQecngQ40Rrodzwr4OQorcKi3kBOBeT48uXt24O_vgFqcntyvBwgRyWxNxJQn3WfSzwzBZBjyrGkQJWP5Tnag-dzBzmG3fH2lP907lQ-ZTxqOCrI8Ye5vP_6efm8QpMHn_7wtnHRBpRYHqXHDk39_6_cB_wbAAD__zpLmDQ) That is the opportunity your generosity can help put in front of her. Right now, **our goal is to reach 500 women facing unexpected pregnancies by August 31** and give them the opportunity to connect with compassionate, life-affirming care before abortion becomes their answer. Will you help us reach them?

Hey friends,
This week I sat down with [Rachel Wells](https://us.list-manage.com/102LYAQjClT?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0), independent journalist and founder of [TN Repro News](https://us.list-manage.com/xjmbbZZzJof?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0), to talk about what's really happening to reproductive healthcare in Tennessee—and it goes well beyond the headlines.

CLICK HERE to[ LISTEN NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/4krqOSVGywI?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)

If you want to **stay informed** on this issue, subscribe to Rachel's newsletter, TN Repro News: [https://wellsrachelm.substack.com/](https://us.list-manage.com/iImHWBjC924?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)
#### [**Listen or watch**](https://us.list-manage.com/gd_beu1maB4?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)**now wherever you get your podcasts. 🎧**

Thank you for being here,Gloria

ALSO HAPPENING THIS WEEK in NASHVILLE...

**Join the conversation:** Saturday, August 22nd11:30 AM - 1 PM📍 David Lusk Gallery | 516 Hagan St., Nashville _**Face in the Thorns:**_ Rachel Wells of TN Repro News joins artist Tess Davies and Francie Hunt of Tennessee Advocates for Planned Parenthood for a conversation exploring art as a reflection of autonomy and resistance. _****_
We get into real patient stories, including a Tennessee woman who was denied prenatal care and had to cross into Virginia to receive care—simply because she was unmarried. We talk about the crisis pregnancy centers now permitted to be the _only_ organizations teaching sex education in our schools, and we also dig into the maternal mortality crisis driven by rural hospital closures (nearly 60% of Tennessee counties don't have an OB or maternal care at their local hospital).
You can hear more from Rachel Wells in Nashville this Saturday, August 22, at ‘Face in the Thorns,’ an Artist x Activist conversation during the 2nd annual [pARTisan exhibition](https://us.list-manage.com/FiXJIJDg6it?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0).

name: Teichert in the Trenches
subject: The Power of Proper Priorities
body:
When I was the squadron commander...
---
| | | | | |
---
| |
💥 The Power of Proper Priorities 💥
Way back in 2011 when I was the squadron commander of the 411th Flight Test Squadron and the director of the F-22 Combined Test Force, I was asked to write a leadership article for the base paper. I thought deeply about the subject of my article and concluded that time management principles (and priority activities for leaders) would be most relevant to every reader.
After all, there is nothing more egalitarian than time. Everyone has the exact same amount of it, and success is ultimately based on how well an individual or organization uses it. This is what I published:
It is a common feeling for almost everyone. We are too busy. There is too much to do and too little time. Growing audiences compete for our attention. Workplaces demand more in spite of shrinking resources. Technological "tools" actually consume more of our time rather than alleviate our workload. How are we to cope?

Time is the great equalizer. Regardless of our upbringing, our rank, our social status, or our standard of living, we all have the same amount of time in any given day. It is up to us to decide how to wisely invest it.

Proper prioritization is the key to budgeting our time properly, and such prioritization does not happen by accident. It takes thought, reflection, and assessment. How often do we get to the end of a very busy day yet feel unfulfilled? How often is our workday characterized by doing a lot but getting nothing important done? Without priority boundaries, our precious time is consumed by the neon sign tasks that attract our attention when they often should simply be ignored.

Priorities must be ingrained into our lives to avoid these pitfalls. One of the wisest uses of our time is a regular period of considering priorities, setting priorities, reflecting on priorities, and assessing our progress toward priorities. Otherwise it is impossible to structure our time in a truly productive way. Without such guiding values, principles, and goals it is easy to be enslaved by our often meaningless to-do lists or the next flashy task that passes our way. Thus, our priorities should structure and triage our tasks so that the tasks themselves don't become priorities by default.

So what should be our workplace priorities? First, they should be our supervisors' priorities. It is their responsibility to share these with us, and if they do not, then we should ask. Otherwise, it is impossible to know if we are properly being utilized to fulfill the organization's mission.

Second, they should be those important items that we can uniquely accomplish. If we don't accomplish these items well, then no one will. As a leader, these may include assessing organizational vision or strategy, setting the example, modeling values, encouraging employees, mentoring subordinate leaders, making the tough decisions, and helping others understand their priorities. Spending time doing anything else may stifle initiative and hinder growth.

As a subordinate, these may include applying our specific expertise, training others in our skill set, seeking opportunities to broaden our experience base, and resolving issues in our sphere of influence before they become our boss's problems. Spending time in other tasks may actually be squandering time itself. If these unique items are not in concert with our supervisors' priorities, then this disconnect must be resolved. It is either the case that a supervisor is unaware of our role, or we are unaware of what our role should be.

Just by following these simple prioritization steps, we can wrestle back some of this most precious resource. In doing so, we quickly realize that many of the tasks that previously consumed us can wait until later, can be done by someone else who is more suited to that particular task, or can be left undone indefinitely.

These concepts go well beyond the workplace, as should our priorities. In fact, areas of our lives like faith and family with horizons beyond our current job and even exceeding our lifetime should be appropriately prioritized ahead of our careers. As a full-time employee, we may not be able to apportion as much time to these priorities as we would like, but we should allocate a proportionate amount of attention, focus, and energy to them. After all, these areas of our lives demand our unique contributions. If we do not set boundaries in our lives to protect these areas, then our time will be consumed in other far less important ways.

Without a time budget, managed by the guiding light of priorities, our tasks will continue to control us. The past is gone for good. The few minutes we spend considering the truths outlined above may allow us to better invest our time from this moment forward.
In retrospect, I particularly appreciate my thoughts about the limited functions of proper leadership. Apart from serving and supporting people, building relationships, and helping the members of your team become the best possible version of themselves, a leader should focus on:
* Casting a bold and compelling vision
* Setting broad limits in the pursuit of that vision
* Appropriately resourcing the achievement of that vision
* Breaking down barriers that hinder a workforce and block achievement of that vision
* Getting out of the way

By properly prioritizing your life and limiting your leadership activities to these specific functions, you can LIVE WELL and LEAD WELL!

* John

# Get Off the Roller Coaster
| |
---
|
---
If you’ve been following the news out of D.C. on federal vaccine policy, you may be feeling a little dizzy. And understandably so. **In just eight months, we’ve seen enough ups, downs, and corkscrews to give anyone whiplash:**
* **January:** An HHS [Decision Memo](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/ty/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTk2MTQxNzA0OTc2MjcwNjcyLFwiclwiOjE5NjE0MTc0MDcxMzgzODQ1MH0iLCJzIjoiZDZmNTY2OWRlNWEzMDliMiJ9) dramatically restructured the federal childhood immunization schedule.
* **March:** Those changes were quickly caught up in litigation and [stayed by federal Judge Brian Murphy](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/ty/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTk2MTQxNzA0OTg3ODA1MDEzLFwiclwiOjE5NjE0MTc0MDcxMzgzODQ1MH0iLCJzIjoiYTRlMGYyYjI4YmIzMTI5OCJ9), who sided with the AAP.
* **May:** President Trump’s [Executive Order on childhood vaccines](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/ty/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTk2MTQxNzA0OTk5MzM5MzUyLFwiclwiOjE5NjE0MTc0MDcxMzgzODQ1MH0iLCJzIjoiZGZlZTM5MWRhM2RlMDRkMiJ9) offered an encouraging step forward, but the CDC remains prohibited from implementing the revised schedule because of the March court stay.
* **June:** A federal appeals court [denied religious exemptions](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/ty/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTk2MTQxNzA1MDA4Nzc2NTM4LFwiclwiOjE5NjE0MTc0MDcxMzgzODQ1MH0iLCJzIjoiYzQ0NGY2YzViMjAxNzc4NCJ9) for Amish families in New York.
* **July:** [Dr. Fauci](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/ty/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTk2MTQxNzA1MDIwMzEwODk2LFwiclwiOjE5NjE0MTc0MDcxMzgzODQ1MH0iLCJzIjoiODBiMjEyMTk4N2UxMDQwNSJ9) refused to answer questions under oath about his tyrannical COVID response and the vaccine roll out.
* **August:** President Trump’s [latest Executive Order](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/ty/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTk2MTQxNzA1MDMzOTQyMzg3LFwiclwiOjE5NjE0MTc0MDcxMzgzODQ1MH0iLCJzIjoiNTM5OTMzNDAyMmY0OTllYyJ9), which also does not bypass the March judicial stay, is better understood as a “policy declaration,” urging states to realign their school vaccine requirements.

That’s a lot to keep up with. But here’s what **we beg you to remember:** **None of this changes our Texas mission.** Yes, TFVC absolutely cares about and advocates for protective federal vaccine policy, particularly [**repealing the 1986 federal law**](https://xdzgmz.clicks.mlsend.com/ty/cl/eyJ2Ijoie1wiYVwiOjEyMDEyNjAsXCJsXCI6MTk2MTQxNzA1MDQ0NDI4MTUxLFwiclwiOjE5NjE0MTc0MDcxMzgzODQ1MH0iLCJzIjoiN2FmMWU5NjU1ZjliY2QyOSJ9) that shields vaccine manufacturers from liability, and we will continue to follow these developments closely. But **chasing the ever-changing federal vaccine schedule** itself is not our focus. **Our focus is something far more fundamental: ensuring every Texan has the legal right to say no to any vaccine at any time, regardless of what happens in Washington. If Texas law protects that right, these federal twists and turns become largely irrelevant.** The federal vaccine schedule roller coaster may keep moving, but our eyes are on Texas.

# **▶️: Two-Thirds of Fourth Graders Can't Read.**
We are the richest nation in the world._So why are two-thirds of fourth graders still not reading at grade level?_**_Watch the video below to hear why I believe it's past time to put our children ahead of politics._**
| [](https://1xz3r.mjt.lu/lnk/AWIAAKLOKhoAAc7YxmYAA-Neh6MAAYKKXNoAoUWGADIMFwBqhFILhAFxZ5usTyGOoBycnSmFYwAtq28/2/ht4cvektAdSbd7NV-Hh85Q/aHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL3JlYWRpbmctaXMtZnVuZGFtZW50YWw)

body:
Trump makes a fool of us on the world stage, cozies up to a dictator, harms our relations with an ally, and makes American Troops less safe.
#
This Sunday, Donald Trump announced he was ordering Pete Hegseth to scale back the United States’ joint military exercises with South Korea.
The reason? Trump asked the President of South Korea to help out with our illegal war with Iran, and they unsurprisingly told him no.
But it’s actually worse than that. In his tweet, he refers to his “very good relationship with Kim Jong Un,” and that he’s not happy we’re running any training operations and war games with South Korea, period. Not just these. All of them.
A few things on this. First, North and South Korea are still _technically_ at war. That war could go hot at literally any moment. These exercises are essential to the readiness of American Troops deployed in South Korea. The border is completely fortified, and the weapons of each nation are always trained on the other.
Second, “very good relationship”? Today is August 18th. Know when North Korea last shot a ballistic missile in our general direction? August 12th. And it was aimed at the area these exercises are supposed to occur.
And third, same as ever, Donald Trump bends over backwards to placate a murderous, repressive, authoritarian dictator over a democratic nation that has been one of our most steadfast allies for 75 years.
Let’s sum up here: Trump makes a fool of us on the world stage, cozies up to a dictator, harms our relations with an ally, and makes American Troops less safe.
Have you had enough of this yet?

clean_body: | Peter, I'm going to make a prediction... When the votes are counted this November, the radical left is going to be in a state of total shock. And the political establishment is going to spend weeks trying to explain what hit them. But that only happens if Republicans like you are on record before the Midterms. That is how consequential this moment is. But here is the part the pundits won't tell you. None of that happens automatically. The Democrats are at war with the American people -- open borders, defunding ICE, eliminating voter ID, putting men in women's sports. You name it, they are on the wrong side of it. And yet they are running the most radical, well-funded Senate candidates in states across this country who are counting on Republicans to stay home and let them walk right in. I will not let that happen. And I don't think you will either. I made you a prediction at the beginning of this email. I stand by every word of it. But that prediction is built on one assumption -- that Republicans like you are engaged and ready to fight. That is where your assessment comes in. Washington politicians like my opponent, Republican Jon Husted, are raising prices for working families, gutting health care to pass tax breaks for billionaires, and giving sweetheart deals to corporations building data centers in your backyard. I know we can defeat Husted and put working people first, but none of this is possible without grassroots support from people like you. And right now, your donation can go twice as far in helping us flip this seat and the Senate. We can build a future where all of us thrive, not just those with major stock portfolios, but it’s going to take a massive grassroots movement full of dedicated folks like you. That’s why I have to ask: = I love Ohio, and I love this country. And when you love this country, you fight for the people who make it work. ## **News from the Campaign Trail**

**Donate. Call. Demand a Debate!**
Nearly 60% of Smucker’s fundraising comes from PACs and special interests – among the highest shares in Pennsylvania’s congressional delegation. Less than 2% comes from small-dollar donors. _So, who is he really working for?_
Smucker is backed by corporate interests and mega-donors. I am powered by people who are tired of being sold out by their representative – and I need your help to fight back.
The contrast is clear: Smucker has time for fancy fundraisers, but not for an in-person town hall with the people he was elected to serve. Now, he has refused to respond to the League of Women Voters’ invitation to debate me.
Voters deserve to hear directly from the candidates for PA-11. If Smucker wants to represent this district, he should be willing to stand before voters, explain where he stands, and debate the issues that matter to our communities.
**Here are two things you can do right now:**
1. **[Donate today](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsEag4ErLzpEhPxLt9QUXR/DwgL3mxA0Uuw)** to help me compete with Smucker’s corporate money and defeat him.
2. **Call Smucker’s office** and demand that he debates me so voters can hear directly from both candidates.

Washington, DC: (202) 225-2411 | Lancaster: (717) 393-0667 | Red Lion: (717) 969-6133 | Hanover: (717) 969-6132
\- Nancy

### **Week in Review:**
| **Building Community, Making “Herstory”** On August 4, Nancy spent the evening with the LanCo Herstory Makers, learning about their work to strengthen community engagement, advance civil action, create safe spaces for children and families, educate residents on civil rights, and collaborate with others across Lancaster County.
---

| **Reclaiming our Voices Rally** Hundreds of people gathered to cheer, boo, clang cow bells and kick off the election season at People Power 2026: Reclaiming Our Voice, a rally hosted by Indivisible Manheim Township, held at Penn Square in Lancaster on Aug. 15.
Nancy was a featured speaker.
“Democracy is not a spectator sport,” she said, emphasizing that it requires people to show up. Then she pointed out the obvious- Lloyd Smucker hasn’t shown up for more than nine years.
Along with the other speakers who are running for office – Brad Chambers who is running for PA House District 41, State House Candidate Jess Branas, and State Representative Nikki Rivera – Nancy answered questions submitted by attendees. In response to a concern about the out-of-control costs of healthcare, Nancy said that the issue wasn’t lack of money, it was spending priority problem.
Under the current administration, tax cuts for billionaires and handouts to corporations, plus spending on the administration’s war of choice against Iran, are the priorities. Nancy said she would pivot those funding priorities and focus on the needs of the people in PA-11 and across the country, including healthcare.
Nancy was recently endorsed, unanimously, by Indivisible Lancaster County and Indivisible York for her candidacy for U.S. Representative for the 11th District of Pennsylvania. She was thankful for this endorsement and very pleased with the invitation to speak at the rally.
The energy at the rally proved that while Smucker has decided to sit on the sidelines, the people of PA-11 are first in line to get out, volunteer, vote and make some noise to defend democracy.

Then she pointed out the obvious- Lloyd Smucker hasn’t shown up for more than nine years. Under the current administration, tax cuts for billionaires and handouts to corporations, plus spending on the administration’s war of choice against Iran, are the priorities. Nancy said she would pivot those funding priorities and focus on the needs of the people in PA-11 and across the country, including healthcare. Nancy was recently endorsed, unanimously, by Indivisible Lancaster County and Indivisible York for her candidacy for U.S. Representative for the 11th District of Pennsylvania. She was thankful for this endorsement and very pleased with the invitation to speak at the rally. | | | “The current assault on participatory democracy is **consistent with a long U.S. history of political machinations intended to ensure power for White men** and keep it at a distance for everyone else, most especially Black Americans.” —CNN Politics
---
**Throughout the years, there has been one throughline in our work at Fair Fight — voter access.**
Creating a world in which each and every eligible American has the freedom to register to vote, cast their ballot, and have that ballot counted fairly — and that they had the information, safety, and comfort that they needed to show up to vote.
That is the driving force behind everything we do.
**Over the last few months, there have been more and more efforts to make voting as burdensome as possible across the South.** Republicans have been fighting tooth and nail to suppress the Black vote. They use racially-neutral language to be brutally racially targeted. You know what that’s called? RACISM.
[**Will you fight back for the freedom to vote with a donation of any amount today?**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/137440344/640809277/-2096927507?refcode=emm_ff_20260818_DirectMail_v1s1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNTg3NmUyNC0wYjliLWYxMTEtOWIzMy0wMDBkM2ExMWZhMzAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=9e7myworBXVsobWO3wAPL-SBuxyyqJ0ILUSfEDIyVOE=)
As the _Los Angeles Times_ put it, **“today's disenfranchisement efforts show less raw violence than in the Klan era, but more sophisticated means of voter suppression.”** The level of sophistication in their playbook is terrifying. In states across the country and in elections both big and small, they have worked quietly to:
* Limit polling locations
* Purge registered voters
* Make voter registration harder
* Require photo IDs and documents that prove citizenship
* Eliminate early voting, vote-by-mail, and ballot drop boxes

**If Republicans do not believe that they can win free and fair elections, they appear ready to try to silence the will of the people.**
This is all part of a broader power grab to ensure the 2026 midterm elections are not free or fair. This is how you hollow out a democracy.
**But Fair Fight is on the frontlines to protect and fight for disenfranchised voters. **
This year, we’re laser-focused on turning out Black voters across the South. That means winning in Mississippi, where we’re funding voter protection work, and carefully monitoring for election interference efforts and anti-voter schemes so we can be prepared to fight back nationally and regionally with partners.
And as we’ve proven again and again in the last few years, we’re going to win in Georgia. We’re going to re-elect Senator Jon Ossoff, win the Governor’s race, and flip the Georgia State House.
With all this work, today and across the years, the connective tissue has always been voter access, particularly for Black voters. We must continue fighting back against Republicans’ racist tactics.
[**But this work takes real resources, and we count on this grassroots team to take action when it matters most. clean_body: We’re up against more efforts to make voting as burdensome as possible | | | | “The current assault on participatory democracy is consistent with a long U.S. history of political machinations intended to ensure power for White men and keep it at a distance for everyone else, most especially Black Americans.” —CNN Politics Throughout the years, there has been one throughline in our work at Fair Fight — voter access. Creating a world in which each and every eligible American has the freedom to register to vote, cast their ballot, and have that ballot counted fairly — and that they had the information, safety, and comfort that they needed to show up to vote. That is the driving force behind everything we do. Over the last few months, there have been more and more efforts to make voting as burdensome as possible across the South. Republicans have been fighting tooth and nail to suppress the Black vote. They use racially-neutral language to be brutally racially targeted. You know what that’s called? RACISM. = As the Los Angeles Times put it, “today's disenfranchisement efforts show less raw violence than in the Klan era, but more sophisticated means of voter suppression.” The level of sophistication in their playbook is terrifying. In states across the country and in elections both big and small, they have worked quietly to: Limit polling locations Purge registered voters Make voter registration harder Require photo IDs and documents that prove citizenship Eliminate early voting, vote-by-mail, and ballot drop boxes If Republicans do not believe that they can win free and fair elections, they appear ready to try to silence the will of the people. This is all part of a broader power grab to ensure the 2026 midterm elections are not free or fair. This is how you hollow out a democracy. But Fair Fight is on the frontlines to protect and fight for disenfranchised voters. ** This year, we’re laser-focused on turning out Black voters across the South. That means winning in Mississippi, where we’re funding voter protection work, and carefully monitoring for election interference efforts and anti-voter schemes so we can be prepared to fight back nationally and regionally with partners. And as we’ve proven again and again in the last few years, we’re going to win in Georgia. We’re going to re-elect Senator Jon Ossoff, win the Governor’s race, and flip the Georgia State House. Peter,
In late 2024 after the dust had settled from the presidential election, a vicious battle was unfolding in the key swing state of North Carolina that threatened to set a terrible precedent that Trump could exploit for his next Big Lie.
The stakes were for a seemingly boring but actually life or death contested state Supreme Court seat that Democrat Allison Riggs had won by 734 votes. But the case held wider consequences for elections everywhere.
The Republican candidate, Jefferson Griffin, launched an expensive 6 month legal Hail Mary to try and have over 60,000 votes cast by North Carolina citizens thrown out. And he nearly succeeded.
If Griffin had prevailed in court, it would have upended a basic principle of election law and democratic fairness: you can't change the rules of an election after the election has taken place.
In the end, the NC Supreme Court with its 5-2 Republican majority seemed inclined to side with Griffin on some of his arguments -- but a federal court decisively blocked it. Griffin conceded shortly after.

MAGA hopes to unseat her. If they defeat Justice Earls, their majority grows to 6-1. However, if Earls holds the line Democrats will have a pathway to reclaiming the majority in 2028.

clean_body: We only have one week left to finish what we started last month. | Four weeks ago, I officially got into this race. One week ago, voters in South Carolina cast their votes for the Primary Special Election. One week from today, the runoff will be over. Fellow Patriot, I am asking for your help - but we're behind where we should be. My opponent has had years to build up their campaigns. I have not. What I do have is almost thirty years of working for the people of South Carolina, the values Lindsey and I were both raised on, and the support of great people like you. Every donation between now and next Tuesday matters now more than ever. It helps us compete with the millions in my opponent's campaign account. I am honored to have President Trump's "Complete and Total Endorsement" and to be running to finish what my brother started. Thank you, Darline Graham P.S. subject: You helped me make history. I need you one more time.

body:
| | | | ,
In 2024, grassroots supporters like you helped me win the closest Senate race in the entire country.

My race came down to 16,000 votes out of 6.5 million cast. And when it was over, when the recount ended and the dust settled, I thought about every single person who showed up when it mattered most.

But I must be honest with you today. Right now, with 11 weeks until Election Day and the Senate majority hanging by a thread, I need you.

Grassroots supporters like you helped me make history once. I am asking you to help us make it again.

The polls are alarming. Democrats are leading in North Carolina, Georgia, Texas, Maine, Ohio, and Alaska. Every race we need to hold. Every seat that determines whether Chuck Schumer gets the gavel back and dismantles everything this majority has built.
Talarico has $70 million in Texas. Soros has written a $50 million check to flip the Senate. The money gap is real and it is showing up in race after race.
I know firsthand what it takes to win. Every dollar, every ad, and every door knocked in the final stretch matters. I lived that in 2024. I am living it again right now watching Republicans across the country fight for their political lives.
Will you chip in today before it is too late?

That’s why I made a promise to come to the Senate and work with fellow political outsiders like President Trump to shake up Washington, and I’m working to do that every single day.
Whether it’s securing the border, reducing crime in our cities, ending the fentanyl epidemic, or bringing down the cost of living–**I’m committed to delivering concrete solutions to the biggest issues we face.**
But in order to get the job done, it’s going to take all hands on deck. I need every freedom-loving American to help me shake up Washington. I promise I won't let you down.
_Senator Dave McCormick_

If you follow firearms news, you have probably seen the headlines: "Suppressors deregulated." "The NFA is dead." "No more tax stamp." Some of it is true, some of it is oversimplified, and almost none of it explains what any of this means for someone living in Mississippi. Here is a plain-language walk through what happened in 2026 and what the law actually says today.
## The old system
For roughly ninety years, certain firearms and accessories have been governed by the National Firearms Act, or NFA, a 1934 law. The NFA doesn't ban these items; it regulates and taxes them. The list includes suppressors (also called silencers), short-barreled rifles (SBRs), short-barreled shotguns (SBSs), machine guns, and a catch-all category called "any other weapons" (AOWs).
To buy one, a person historically had to file an ATF Form 4, submit fingerprints and photographs, pass a federal background check, pay a $200 tax, and then wait -- often many months -- for the ATF to approve the transfer. Only after approval could the buyer take possession. That $200 stamp and the registration paperwork were the defining features of NFA ownership.
## What Congress changed
In 2025, Congress passed a budget law (Public Law 119-21) that reduced the NFA making and transfer tax to **$0** for suppressors, SBRs, SBSs, and AOWs, effective January 1, 2026. Machine guns and destructive devices were left alone and still carry the $200 tax.
One important point that often gets lost: Congress did **not** remove these items from the NFA. An earlier version of the bill would have done exactly that, but the Senate parliamentarian ruled that the removal language couldn't stay in a budget bill under the chamber's rules. So what survived was only the tax reduction. On paper, the registration requirement and the Form 4 remained fully in place -- just with a $0 price tag.
## The court ruling
That tax change set up the legal fight that followed. On August 5, 2026, the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of Texas decided _Silencer Shop Foundation v. ATF_ (consolidated with a case backed by the NRA and Firearms Policy Coalition).
The court's reasoning is worth understanding, because it explains why the ruling exists at all. The NFA has always been justified as an exercise of Congress's power to tax. The court held that a tax which collects no revenue is not really a tax -- quoting an earlier Supreme Court decision, it noted that "an essential feature of a tax is that it produces at least some revenue. A tax set at $0 produces none." With the tax gone, the court found, the registration-and-approval machinery lost its constitutional footing for the items whose tax had been zeroed out. It therefore struck down the NFA registration requirement as applied to suppressors, SBRs, and SBSs.
In short: because the tax on those items is now zero, the court said the government can no longer require the Form 4 registration for them -- for the people the ruling actually covers.
## The catch: who is actually covered
This is the part the headlines usually skip. Because of a 2025 U.S. Supreme Court decision that curtailed nationwide "universal" injunctions, the Texas court could only grant relief to the parties in front of it. The injunction bars the government from enforcing the challenged NFA provisions against the plaintiffs and, where applicable, their members, their customers, and the fifteen states that formally joined the case. It is **not** a nationwide ruling, and it does not automatically apply to everyone in the country.
Mississippi was not one of the states that joined the lawsuit. As a result, a Mississippi resident is not covered simply by living here; coverage would depend on being a member of one of the plaintiff organizations or purchasing from a covered dealer.
## The government is letting the ruling stand
Ordinarily a decision like this would be tied up on appeal for months or years. That is not what happened here. The court issued its ruling with a seven-day stay, and that stay expired at midnight Central on August 13, 2026 **without the Department of Justice filing an appeal**. By declining to seek a longer pause, the Trump administration allowed the ruling to take effect, and the first lawful transfers of unregistered suppressors reportedly took place that same morning.
The administration has also signaled it does not intend to fight the decision at all. Representative Andrew Clyde of Georgia said he "received confirmation from the Trump Administration that the DOJ will NOT appeal." The DOJ itself has not issued a formal public statement, so the strongest evidence is the government's own conduct -- declining a stay and letting the deadline pass -- together with that confirmation relayed through Congress.
Two caveats keep this from being fully settled. First, letting the short stay lapse is not the same as the appeal window closing entirely; under the normal federal rules the government has roughly sixty days from the August 5 judgment -- into early October 2026 -- to change course and file a notice of appeal. All indications are that it will not, but that window technically remains open. Second, because the relief is party-limited, the ruling does not, by itself, extend to Americans who were not part of the case. There is ongoing discussion in Congress and at the ATF about whether to broaden the relief so it applies nationwide, but unless and until that happens, the geographic patchwork remains.
## What still applies everywhere
Even where the Form 4 requirement has been lifted, several things did not change. A buyer still completes a standard Form 4473 and passes a NICS background check through a licensed dealer. People legally prohibited from owning firearms still cannot buy these items. State-law bans and restrictions still control. And machine guns and destructive devices remain fully regulated under the NFA, $200 tax included.
## Current Mississippi law
Mississippi's own statutes matter as much as the federal ruling, and here the picture is specific.
For suppressors, Mississippi Code Section 97-37-31 makes it a misdemeanor to make, sell, or possess a suppressor unless the person is "duly authorized under federal law." In plain terms, Mississippi ties the legality of a suppressor directly to federal authorization. State law does not independently create a suppressor registry; it points back to the federal system.
Mississippi also has a lesser-known statute, Section 45-9-81, the "Made in Mississippi" suppressor law enacted in 2023. It declares that a suppressor manufactured and kept entirely within the state is not subject to federal regulation, under a states'-rights theory tied to interstate commerce. Similar laws in other states have generally not held up when challenged in federal court, so its practical effect is uncertain.
For short-barreled rifles, short-barreled shotguns, and machine guns, Mississippi does not impose its own separate possession ban -- these items are lawful to possess in the state so long as the owner complies with applicable federal law. Concealed-carry rules are handled separately under other statutes.
## The bottom line
As of today, the tax on suppressors, SBRs, and SBSs is zero everywhere. A federal court has ruled the registration requirement for those items unconstitutional, and the Department of Justice has chosen not to appeal, allowing the decision to take effect. But that relief reaches only the specific parties and states covered by the case -- Mississippi is not among them -- and the formal appeal window does not fully close until early October. On top of that, Mississippi's own law still ties suppressor legality to federal authorization.
The result is a genuinely confusing moment, where national headlines and on-the-ground reality don't quite match. A buyer in a covered state may face a very different process than a buyer in Mississippi, even though the federal tax is now the same everywhere. Anyone making a purchasing decision should treat this as a fast-moving area of law, follow how the relief is extended (or not) in the weeks ahead, and consult a qualified attorney rather than relying on a headline. This article is intended as a general explanation, not legal advice.

They said I couldn’t win last time. Now they’re saying it again.

subject: RE: No blank check for Big Tech data centers
body:
A 3-year pause gives communities time to understand the real costs before corporations lock them in for decades. | |
---
Peter, **Big Tech is pouring billions of dollars into a massive expansion of data centers to fuel artificial intelligence, cryptocurrency mining, cloud computing, and other technologies.** Communities are being asked to accept the consequences before the full costs are even understood. Data centers consume enormous amounts of electricity and water while increasing pressure on the electric grid, contributing to higher utility costs, producing around-the-clock noise, adding pollution -- all while Big Tech corporations demand public subsidies. By 2030, data centers are projected to consume 12% of all U.S. electricity, roughly triple their current share and equal to all other industries combined. **Working families should not be forced to subsidize an industry dominated by some of the richest corporations on Earth while communities are left with higher bills and strained resources. No neighborhood should become a sacrifice zone for Big Tech's expansion.** [**Send an urgent message to your governor and state legislators now demanding a 3-year statewide moratorium on new hyperscale data centers in your state.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uU1mwbYMW9amKE-asg_toD74K_fy9-sZiUkGFavlgPCt46JMm1kakwmzPAa-J2OTUj4_GwJNrSHGLvbgLyLVyodjiH7nBMqK5M6elNN3DAMr5LY5b2OpoINI4lmhLBanzd_3Z57kbOjWBT7zS4Z42oaAwaSLFIUzY6q-r822bXVq8y77-XJk6uqm9y3XPmIHv_DcvIPFoiqoz5AEJUm2-DjssshjDYT4tmfx0c46CTUazOK7kot_YCUHhjLErxd8H_nF-1B37xlhZNRMmvaQLxSiBKL0LoH1_EPHxff1Pd8zStaKO_DXUrJZpgzur_NgWZ42wITXU864OizNM4uivNq9A-YoB4qX4IkwI7g6ThhqzSRc_5bxkx-g8iZdY_Jw/4ta/CDmZdtf2TEKcRtHLHwTFDQ/h0/h001.sHmi1MWYPoCRPRTq9yRjYxKN1hLCl7qQCtGVNNvfPCc) | | [SIGN & SEND](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39uU1mwbYMW9amKE-asg_toD74K_fy9-sZiUkGFavlgPCt46JMm1kakwmzPAa-J2OTUj4_GwJNrSHGLvbgLyLVyodjiH7nBMqK5M6elNN3DAPMtR1QX7KiSKXI5YdAKwdoJFk7JAF468NrNoOBDFcHzoK5m8-NKKaEeqOLBWe0PgtWwLvL0DDkuR-J94Mt3q3ZJSl4gy9dTywFawiQLYKg2CkIYO55SGgz9PMvqRg3OEkV3Y4f9mtP9pblTYV7fPd2Few9npFgOzIAqTRbV0IZZ6LRy3nVWtYkbUq29S1hL28LamIhHJ6gVwsE0ZvVPYxoJvARysjRCpltRJXJ-mRficv4RMnZM5n_JrYnL0-_PPu35YI3CvWHYHkZmvJWlris/4ta/CDmZdtf2TEKcRtHLHwTFDQ/h1/h001.ORrJj_vK_KDftvFRyNy46zXx96NeiHkUgrpvmQ2fik0)
