name: Tim Burchett
subject: I have a hot take
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Burchett for Congress
body:
Before the pancake crowd comes after me with pitchforks, read what’s been on my mind.

| Hey Peter, it’s Tim Burchett.
I have what my younger staff call a “hot take”: [Waffles are better than pancakes.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.-KDRbft8w)
There. I said it.
A pancake’s fine, but a waffle has some backbone to it. Those little squares hold the butter and syrup right where the Good Lord intended. And if you’ve ever seen me at a Waffle House, you already know which side of this debate I’m on.
---
[](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.)
---
Now, before the pancake crowd comes after me with pitchforks, let me tell you why I’m really writing.
I’ve been thinking lately about how dadgum strange this job can be.
One minute I’m sitting in a Waffle House drinking coffee, and the next I’m back in Washington arguing with people who could complicate a two-car funeral.
Somewhere in between all that, it’s easy to forget why you got into the fight in the first place.
So I wrote a few things down. Not a campaign speech. Not something cooked up in a conference room. Just what’s been on my mind lately about Tennessee, this country, and the people I’m lucky enough to work for.
[Peter, I’d sure appreciate it if you gave it a read.](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.)
---
| [READ MY NOTE](https://trk.email.tim-burchett.)
---
And for the record, I’m still right about the waffles.
Thank y’all for sending me here,Tim Burchett

Palestinian children attending the Al-Karama School in the Sheikh Radwan neighborhood of northern Gaza City on August 15, 2026. Photo by Rasha Abou Jalal.
GAZA CITY--Thirteen-year-old Saida Abdullah stood in front of several dozen of her classmates gathered under sheets of tarp strung up among olive trees on a plot of farmland in the Sheikh Radwan neighborhood of northern Gaza City on Saturday. "Long live a free and Arab Palestine," she cried out. "Glory and eternity to our righteous martyrs." The children repeated the slogans after her and commenced a new school day at the Al-Karama School, one of a number of makeshift educational facilities established over the past several months in Gaza, where the schooling system has been decimated by Israel's genocidal war.
The Al-Karama School, which accommodates 200 boys and girls and provides classes to children from four to 17 years old, lacks the most basic of educational resources. Students receive their lessons sitting on the ground in one of two tents or in the open air, without notebooks, desks, or a blackboard.
The director of the school, Ghadeer Odeh, told Drop Site News she founded the school after the so-called ceasefire in October 2025, "to fight the ignorance that has come to threaten a new generation of Palestinians in Gaza."
Before the genocide, Palestinians in Gaza and the West Bank had one of the highest literacy rates in the world, reaching over 97% in 2020, despite Israel's brutal occupation. Yet for nearly three years in a row now, close to 700,000 Palestinian children have been deprived of formal in-person schooling in Gaza, according to UNICEF. Nearly 98% of school buildings in Gaza were damaged and over 93% of them (526 out of 564) require major rehabilitation or full reconstruction to be functional again. Any classrooms that remain usable have been converted into displacement shelters.
Over the course of the war, some 20,000 school-age children and over 530 teachers in Gaza have been killed by Israel, according to Monir Abu Zaiter, the director of education in East Gaza. Tens of thousands more have been wounded, many with life-changing injuries. The "ceasefire" has not stopped the slaughter, with at least 300 children killed by Israel since the agreement came into effect in October, an average of one child killed every day. According to Abu Zaiter, some 19,500 students have also left Gaza since the beginning of the war.
"Beyond missed school days, the crisis is driving severe learning loss: without regular instruction and practice, children's foundational literacy and numeracy skills are eroding, making it harder to re-enter schooling and progress at age-appropriate levels," UNICEF said in an April [report](https://substack.com/redirect/cb58c4ec-dc97-445b-9d35-3a35c9f3e562?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Amid the devastation, government-led educational initiatives, and community ones like Al-Karama School, are doing what they can to fill the void.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/71a5d169-e0f0-418b-a82e-e5546ddf38d8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
###### Saida Abdullah, 13, leads students in morning chants before the start of a school day at Al-Karama School in the Sheikh Radwan neighborhood of northern Gaza City on August 15, 2026. Video by Rasha Abou Jalal.
## **Al-Karama School**
Soon after Israel launched its assault in October 2023, Odeh and her family were forced to leave their home in Gaza City. In the ensuing months, they were displaced 13 times--fleeing from different parts of the Strip as they tried to survive the relentless bombardment. Soon after the "ceasefire" went into effect on October 10, 2025, and the scorched earth bombing campaign was reduced to sporadic attacks, Odeh returned to Gaza City and founded Al-Karama School a month later.
The school teaches only four subjects: Arabic, English, mathematics, and science. Other subjects that Gaza students studied before the war, such as physical education, arts, technology, and civics were dropped. Similar to other educational initiatives established in Gaza, Al-Karama School places a strong emphasis on improving children's mental health and coping with massive amounts of trauma from living through nearly three years of a genocide defined by aerial bombardment, displacement, and starvation.
This past weekend, Al-Karama School organized a summer camp for students with the aim of working to alleviate their psychological suffering. Children sang and performed dances together amid the scattered olive groves and were given space to talk about their experiences and what they had witnessed.
Thirteen-year-old Mais Fayad addressed the rest of the students and spoke with a painful eloquence far beyond her years. "The war killed what remained of our dreams and destroyed our homes and schools. This war is painful. It tore our hearts apart with fear and terror. What heart could possibly hold all of this, oh God? You feel that your happiness is a betrayal, your comfort is a betrayal, and the roof over your head is a betrayal. You feel ashamed to be happy so that you do not betray their grief, and you suppress the pain of your helplessness, apologizing to them for remaining alive," she said.
Aseel Shaher, whose 12-year-old son Mohammed attends Al-Karama School, told Drop Site the war created a new generation of students deprived of an education but that schools like Al-Karama "gave us hope that life could return to Gaza again."
Shaher and her family were displaced more than seven times during the war. They were driven into poverty after her husband lost his clothing store, forcing the family to send Mohammed to work in the street markets to help provide food for the household. "I was never happy about my child working. But there was nothing we could do," Shaher said. "Now what I had been hoping for has happened: my child has stopped working in the market and returned to learning."
Over the past several months, mosques, community centers, and public libraries have opened their doors to students to serve as temporary educational centers. The makeshift schools are able to function only because hundreds of teachers have volunteered their time and effort.
"Popular educational initiatives provide students with instruction in core subjects, alongside recreational activities and programs to ease the burden of the war on students and compensate them, to some extent, for the education and schooling they have lost," Mohammed Al-Koumi, a volunteer Arabic-language teacher, told Drop Site. "Children in Palestine have the right to learn, play, and achieve the hopes and ambitions that the war has killed."
Al-Koumi also noted that while the war had slowed, it has not ended, and parents continue to worry about sending their children to school for fear of them getting bombed, shelled, or shot by the Israeli military.
The Ministry of Education in Gaza has also sought to promote remote learning as a way to involve more children, with lessons uploaded by teachers online and made available on mobile applications. However, a severe deterioration in internet services as a result of Israel targeting telecommunications towers, frequent electricity cuts, and a severe shortage of smartphones and computers as a result of the Israeli blockade, has left large segments of the student population unable to access online lessons. Only 14% of the total number of students are currently enrolled in online education, according to Abu Zaiter.
As a result, parents, teachers, and volunteers have worked to create in-person alternatives and community initiatives that allow children to continue their education face-to-face, albeit under extremely limited conditions and resources.
Numerous fundraising campaigns have been launched to collect donations to provide the basic necessities required for some level of in-person education. Some initiatives have managed to provide desks, tables, and blackboards for students and teachers.
Community- and government-led educational projects have played a significant role in providing "temporary schools" for students, according to Abu Zaiter, with some 400,000 children enrolled in some kind of school program. Yet nearly 130,000 children--or one fifth of all students--remain outside of the education process, Abu Zaiter said.
While local and international institutions, including UNICEF, have provided important support to the devastated education sector, the scale of support remains far below actual needs, he added.
Educational initiatives like Al-Karama School "remain temporary solutions that cannot be relied upon for many years," Abu Zaiter said. He stressed that Israel needed to open the crossings into Gaza to allow for construction materials, equipment, and resources--including notebooks and pencils--in order to begin to rehabilitate Gaza's school infrastructure.
Speaking to the other children at Al-Karama School, 13-year-old Fayyad put it succinctly. "We are the broken children of Gaza, whose hearts have been shattered by the war, deprived of their dreams and ambitions and their schools. Don't we have the right to learn? Don't we have the right to live in a safe place, achieve our dreams, and sleep in peace and tranquility?"

# [Rare books are being systematically destroyed for Amazon's AI training](https://substack.com/redirect/7b3c3f2a-3b74-4ca9-82a5-063dfb4f44ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

---|---|---
* **Tracking device arrives:** 404 Media placed a tracking device in a rare book that ultimately arrived at Amazon's VGT3 facility in Las Vegas featuring a dinosaur holding a book.
* **Amazon issues statement:** The company said it purchases books through commercial channels to improve the products and services customers use in response to the report.
* **Valuable rare texts:** Out-of-print or hard-to-find rare books provide training data not available online and free of any AI-generated content from before 2022.
* **Avoiding model collapse:** LLMs risk model collapse and degraded output quality when trained on too much AI-generated text already ingested from the internet.

# [House sellers outnumber buyers 51% but the American dream stays out of reach](https://substack.com/redirect/7b3c3f2a-3b74-4ca9-82a5-063dfb4f44ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Redfin data shows 966,752 active homebuyers in July, the lowest on record, while 1,462,921 homes for sale left sellers **[outnumbering buyers by 51.3% in a frozen market.](https://substack.com/redirect/6ab399a1-2936-43bd-b99e-c239d47df0cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7b3c3f2a-3b74-4ca9-82a5-063dfb4f44ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Metros tip toward buyers:** Thirty-nine of 49 major metropolitan areas qualified as buyer's markets with sellers outnumbering buyers by more than 10%, led by Miami at 154% more sellers.
* **Mortgage rates stay elevated:** The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate stood at 6.67% on August 13, nearly matching last year's 6.58% and keeping monthly payments high.
* **New home prices ease:** Newly built houses averaged $502,700 in the second quarter, down from a $541,300 record late last year, yet still costly with rates near 7%.
* **Leverage exists for some:** Redfin economist Asad Khan noted buyers who remain have options and motivated sellers may negotiate before any early-fall rush brings activity back.

# [Miami now costs more than New York yet smart money still flees Mamdani](https://substack.com/redirect/7b3c3f2a-3b74-4ca9-82a5-063dfb4f44ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Bloomberg data shows Miami's overall cost of living now exceeds New York's, yet top developers argue **[zero state income tax, cheaper building and quality of life still favor South Florida.](https://substack.com/redirect/c3e4ec05-84a8-42e8-b5a1-2d0d81a79c2e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7b3c3f2a-3b74-4ca9-82a5-063dfb4f44ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Housing costs climb higher:** South Florida housing costs are roughly 5% higher than New York while home prices jumped 79% since the pandemic and insurance averages $8292, four times New York levels.
* **Building remains more affordable:** Constructing high-rises stays significantly less expensive in Florida than New York according to PMG's Ryan Shear, with debt costs comparable nationally.
* **Tax math drives decisions:** Florida has no state or city income tax while New York top earners face nearly 14.8% combined rates and effective brackets of 50 to 55%.
* **Companies plant permanent roots:** Major employers now relocate headquarters to Miami rather than satellite offices, marking a tipping point as PMG itself shifted its primary base from New York.

# [Kraken launches debit card with up to 2% cash back](https://substack.com/redirect/7b3c3f2a-3b74-4ca9-82a5-063dfb4f44ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Crypto exchange Kraken is rolling out the Krak Card, a U.S. debit card **[offering up to 2% cash or bitcoin back paid as money,](https://substack.com/redirect/b193c7f2-a8e5-46fb-bec0-c053b4db51ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as it competes with fintech apps to capture more of customers' everyday spending and deposits.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7b3c3f2a-3b74-4ca9-82a5-063dfb4f44ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Rewards scale with holdings:** The Krak Card provides up to 2% cash or bitcoin back that increases based on the value of assets a customer holds on the platform, paid directly rather than in points.
* **Spend across 600 assets:** Users can spend directly from more than 600 currencies and crypto assets with automatic conversion to dollars at purchase, customizable order and split options across balances.
* **Targets fintech competition:** The launch puts Kraken in direct competition with Block's CashApp, PayPal's Venmo, SoFi, Robinhood and Chime as crypto embeds deeper into mainstream finance.
* **Addresses consumer distrust:** Co-CEO Arjun Sethi cited a survey of more than 2,000 adults showing 63% feel financially behind and 60% would switch for meaningful rewards without taking on debt.

# [Monterey auctions hit record $747.9 million sales](https://substack.com/redirect/7b3c3f2a-3b74-4ca9-82a5-063dfb4f44ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Classic car auctions during Monterey Car Week **[generated a record $747.9 million through Saturday](https://substack.com/redirect/10f8289d-c5a1-4973-8a6c-63e298937c64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while a 1935 Duesenberg once owned by Clark Gable took Best of Show at Pebble Beach.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7b3c3f2a-3b74-4ca9-82a5-063dfb4f44ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Record sales surge:** Total sales reached $747.9 million, a 73% jump from $432.8 million in 2025 and surpassing the prior record of $471 million set in 2022.
* **Average prices climb:** Sell-through rate held at 75% with 844 of 1,124 lots sold as the average sale price rose 64% to $866,107 from $529,034 a year earlier.
* **Top auction results:** A 1964 Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe sold for $42.9 million, a record for an American car, while a 1996 McLaren F1 fetched $34.7 million.
* **Duesenberg wins show:** The 1935 Duesenberg SSJ Special Speedster, one of only two made and once owned by Clark Gable, won Best of Show shown by collector Harry Yeaggy.

# [Buc-ee's just dropped a 74,000-square-foot beast in Arkansas](https://substack.com/redirect/7b3c3f2a-3b74-4ca9-82a5-063dfb4f44ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Buc-ee's opened its first Arkansas travel center in Benton on Monday, **[a 74,000-square-foot facility with 120 fueling positions](https://substack.com/redirect/dfa4bbad-7f2f-409b-ba15-5c7214f473a9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** that will create more than 200 jobs as the Texas chain expands.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7b3c3f2a-3b74-4ca9-82a5-063dfb4f44ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Benton location details emerge:** The store at 1400 Highway 229 features Texas barbecue, homemade fudge, kolaches, Beaver Nuggets, jerky, fresh pastries and the chain's famously clean restrooms that attract travelers.
* **Nationwide total hits 58:** Founded in 1982 with 37 Texas stores, Buc-ee's now operates across Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Mississippi, Missouri, Ohio, South Carolina, Tennessee and Virginia.
* **Recent openings fuel pace:** The Arkansas debut came five days after a San Marcos, Texas, opening on August 12, following first Ohio location in April and Arizona debut in June.
* **Expansion pipeline continues:** Next is Murfreesboro, Tennessee on November 16, then six sites in 2027 including Ruston, Louisiana and Kansas City, Kansas, with more planned through 2031.

# [Palmer Luckey calls ex-Taco Bell CEO a "bitter, used-up old man"](https://substack.com/redirect/7b3c3f2a-3b74-4ca9-82a5-063dfb4f44ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Anduril co-founder **[Palmer Luckey fired back at former Yum Brands CEO Greg Creed](https://substack.com/redirect/7fc96c5b-2ddf-4a72-8383-0f281c067a69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[ ](https://substack.com/redirect/7fc96c5b-2ddf-4a72-8383-0f281c067a69?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)after the latter criticized McDonald's new Refreshers beverage line and Red Bull collaboration on LinkedIn.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d96ee6cb-701a-4fe3-9039-d49d0995a5bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Bitter response draws views:** Luckey called Creed a bitter used-up old man who takes pot shots, noting the former neighbor was mad about him hosting the President, as the post hit 1.2 million views.
* **Creed questions brand fit:** The ex-Taco Bell CEO said the 6-8 new drinks add operational complexity and lack anything distinctively McDonald's, suggesting a name like McEnergizer instead.
* **Luckey defends strategy:** He argued McDonald's aims to ride the existing fruit-plus-caffeine Refresher fad already successful at Starbucks, Taco Bell and others rather than invent a new brand descriptor.
* **Real world eater claims:** Luckey admitted he is no expert but lives in the real world and regularly eats at all these places, challenging defenders of Creed's reasoning.

Crypto exchange Kraken is rolling out the Krak Card, a U.S. debit card as it competes with fintech apps to capture more of customers' everyday spending and deposits. | | ---|---|--- Rewards scale with holdings: The Krak Card provides up to 2% cash or bitcoin back that increases based on the value of assets a customer holds on the platform, paid directly rather than in points. Spend across 600 assets: Users can spend directly from more than 600 currencies and crypto assets with automatic conversion to dollars at purchase, customizable order and split options across balances. Targets fintech competition: The launch puts Kraken in direct competition with Block's CashApp, PayPal's Venmo, SoFi, Robinhood and Chime as crypto embeds deeper into mainstream finance. Addresses consumer distrust: Co-CEO Arjun Sethi cited a survey of more than 2,000 adults showing 63% feel financially behind and 60% would switch for meaningful rewards without taking on debt. | | | | ---|---|--- | Aug 16 | Classic car auctions during Monterey Car Week while a 1935 Duesenberg once owned by Clark Gable took Best of Show at Pebble Beach. | | ---|---|--- Record sales surge: Total sales reached $747.9 million, a 73% jump from $432.8 million in 2025 and surpassing the prior record of $471 million set in 2022. Average prices climb: Sell-through rate held at 75% with 844 of 1,124 lots sold as the average sale price rose 64% to $866,107 from $529,034 a year earlier. Top auction results: A 1964 Shelby Cobra Daytona Coupe sold for $42.9 million, a record for an American car, while a 1996 McLaren F1 fetched $34.7 million. Duesenberg wins show: The 1935 Duesenberg SSJ Special Speedster, one of only two made and once owned by Clark Gable, won Best of Show shown by collector Harry Yeaggy. Buc-ee's opened its first Arkansas travel center in Benton on Monday, that will create more than 200 jobs as the Texas chain expands. | | ---|---|--- Benton location details emerge: The store at 1400 Highway 229 features Texas barbecue, homemade fudge, kolaches, Beaver Nuggets, jerky, fresh pastries and the chain's famously clean restrooms that attract travelers. Nationwide total hits 58: Founded in 1982 with 37 Texas stores, Buc-ee's now operates across Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Mississippi, Missouri, Ohio, South Carolina, Tennessee and Virginia. Recent openings fuel pace: The Arkansas debut came five days after a San Marcos, Texas, opening on August 12, following first Ohio location in April and Arizona debut in June. Expansion pipeline continues: Next is Murfreesboro, Tennessee on November 16, then six sites in 2027 including Ruston, Louisiana and Kansas City, Kansas, with more planned through 2031. Anduril co-founder the latter criticized McDonald's new Refreshers beverage line and Red Bull collaboration on LinkedIn. | | ---|---|--- Bitter response draws views: Luckey called Creed a bitter used-up old man who takes pot shots, noting the former neighbor was mad about him hosting the President, as the post hit 1.2 million views. Creed questions brand fit: The ex-Taco Bell CEO said the 6-8 new drinks add operational complexity and lack anything distinctively McDonald's, suggesting a name like McEnergizer instead. Luckey defends strategy: He argued McDonald's aims to ride the existing fruit-plus-caffeine Refresher fad already successful at Starbucks, Taco Bell and others rather than invent a new brand descriptor. Real world eater claims: Luckey admitted he is no expert but lives in the real world and regularly eats at all these places, challenging defenders of Creed's reasoning. | | | | | | Peter,
You don’t need a politician to tell you that life in Pennsylvania is getting more expensive. You feel it every month.
❌ Your electric bill is higher than it was a year ago — and another increase is coming
❌ Your natural gas bill is going up this fall
❌ Your property taxes keep climbing
❌ Insurance premiums — homeowners, auto, health — are all up
❌ Groceries and everyday essentials cost more than they did two years ago
And what is Josh Shapiro doing about any of it?
Nothing. He’s the highest-paid governor in America, presiding over the 47th-ranked economy in the country, and he doesn’t have a single plan to lower your costs.
**We do.**
Here’s what a Garrity Administration will do to make life affordable again:
⚡ Cut your utility bills by 15–25% by eliminating hidden costs on electric bills, rolling back the gross receipts tax, and much more.
🏠 Launch the HOPE for PA initiative to cut property taxes by one-third within two years — so seniors stop losing homes they’ve lived in for decades
💰 Reduce the overall tax burden — Pennsylvania has the 5th highest in the nation, and it’s driving families and businesses out of the state
🏭 Make data centers pay their own way — so big tech stops driving up your energy costs
🔑 Create a first-time homebuyer program covering up to 3% of mortgage interest rates
Pennsylvanians are working harder, paying more, and getting less. That’s not an accident — it’s the result of a Governor who cares more about his political future than your financial present.
It’s time to turn Pennsylvania around.
– Team Garrity

name: Doug Ollivant for Congress
subject: Vindman walked out on his own constituents
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY OLLIVANT FOR CONGRESS
body:
He lashed out, then storms out. His 15 minutes are over.

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/qreUHjUL2M5?e=14c77a6723&c2id=09489c9156c428bed3a67a2822595ae0)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

Friends and Neighbors,
In case you missed it, last week in King George County, Congressman Yevgeny Vindman faced pointed criticism from his own constituents. A necessary conversation turned into raised voices and obscenities from a sitting Congressman.
He later apologized. That is to his credit. _But the moment still matters._
**👉 Full Details Here: **[Virginia Free Press | Vindman, Democratic Activists Owe Constituents Better in VA07 ](https://us.list-manage.com/cHvsHaJDYr0?e=14c77a6723&c2id=09489c9156c428bed3a67a2822595ae0)
**👉 Additional coverage from Uriah Kiser: **[Virginia Insider | Eugene Vindman Curses Out Own Voters in VA-7 ](https://us.list-manage.com/R1_2xsdVnvm?e=14c77a6723&c2id=09489c9156c428bed3a67a2822595ae0)
_As a fellow veteran who took the same oath_ Vindman once did in uniform, I found the exchange troubling. That oath is about service to the American people. And for an elected official, their duty is to serve their constituents with patience and respect, not dismissal.
It’s clear Yevgeny “Eugene” Vindman’s 15 minutes of impeachment fame is over. The people of Virginia’s 7th want to move forward and are focused on the rising costs we see our energy bills; as well as building a future for our children and grandchildren.
Those are not Vindman’s priorities. He remains _ideologically misaligned and physically disconnected_ from the district he represents. _**Yevgeny made it clear when he fired VA-07 the moment he had an opportunity.**_
I took the same oath and intend to honor it by putting this district first. Help me flip this seat.
[**Donate HERE $500, $250, $100, $50, $25 or chip in whatever you can today**](https://us.list-manage.com/Edfi2yK12O6?e=14c77a6723&c2id=09489c9156c428bed3a67a2822595ae0)
Every contribution helps us reach more voters who want leaders who listen first and _**won’t respond with obscenities**_.
Thank you for your support.
Let’s get to work.
****

**Republican Nominee for U.S. Congress****Virginia’s 7th Congressional District**

You’ve probably noticed that a lot of political emails are designed to make you panic.

**500% MATCH!
YOU MUST DONATE!
WE ARE BEGGING YOU!**
I've never wanted to talk to you that way – and I won’t start now.

The truth is, candidates who rely on manufactured urgency usually do it because they don't have much else to offer. This campaign does.

We're running to get corporate money out of politics, to make healthcare a right for all, and to finally put working families ahead of the donors who've owned this seat for two decades.

Those stakes are real. I don't need to invent them. So here's an honest update instead of a scary one.

Daniel's parents brought him here from Mexico when he was 11. He grew up in Texas, worked his tail off, and it showed. He graduated valedictorian, earned two degrees from SMU, went on to advanced training in AI, and volunteered around his community the whole way through. He never had any criminal record at all. Last August he got pulled over in a minor traffic stop, and ICE took him.
---
[ **KEEP FAMILIES TOGETHER, FLIP TX-03** ](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt88vYjUpFJYaGZm6wqGRF5E21KWmsNv2Dns9d_liBZCImJ_dfgCYJVwSMKPJEiQRoP63xdUtiqRg1iar7-cqDbk0DKBsXDxET2nny4LoKJUIQQXcQ8XTz7i7Ff0coJlpYUlVv53upAoPGzMrfKsPks6UdaigLP0Vm5gR3269GzAyjAeSDC_F5si7WwAcF5hXFrE1HXyHwOctOxHn0xb5mJVfyqB7gma6ZTG3KvBDZs8HD7nhszSZLbP-GDJuO0ze52EQKRmqS78jphblHYxJbDYwkLzef4ZOnv5OYb7a7_xFn6HqPHmG_bDLfWqkoJzMrn0dpHntsmi9GdRHbsfn3MkV3AyqnyENGabRn_uqVkLB9In0HYYPsQxGzgbNpaQNUBxwM1XiyzQN4Y8Jrv0InxnL8IpOkQKLhafm9Ey7ye2RK/4ta/fRu1td85QCun07a7sYN6YQ/h2/h001._AcH-6-oZsQErOVd3QfYfsbcRqx1jV_nLUGdL6Xc3N0)

Sarah is an American citizen who was in law school at the time.
And while she fought for Daniel, government lawyers dug up her old dating history and brought it up in the proceedings. _Think about that lunacy for a second._ Her own government went after her personal life because she stood by her husband. The two of them got married inside the detention center, and when his lawyer told him an appeal meant many more months locked up with no guarantee at the end, Daniel gave up and left for Mexico. Sarah dropped out of law school after that. **She told me she went into law because she wanted to help people, and after what she watched it do to Daniel, she could not stomach it anymore.** Now she is leaving the country she was born in to be with her husband. [**Help us fight for families like theirs, because right now almost nobody in Washington is.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt88vYjUpFJYaGZm6wqGRF5E21KWmsNv2Dns9d_liBZCImtXjJEoZMKzJcfFAqR5wesSU-Lx-kIRc12Z3snddPye-NIJSpKEzU-qnRPvbQRo4XFig4gsb7HOt3yntVlmBG3uMVZHUntzK_chKLG3cAAEy4fZ70EC4x260z2nuajGsNLkgR9XRavyz-VHnSXnj9tn6KjVgKNMMp3D15c-EEHdJK0naJx-7MXcjR0XEL2mWwUPa_oR-FAcwRATdgA9__GnWDCPgOkXbGzugp3mIxFRGnwt39ssvMZ01t1rkjJLpJMRqeseka0eJrR4w_ZTIbwdbjgap61E3poIvFIhJjLZ1GrjCngZsLAaoMP-ZBMzv_7YwDDGinn-RdACD57IZ_divkO6CzSb_p1SQRNgtcbFjHcKm1gwgB2JNdB2zGb88-/4ta/fRu1td85QCun07a7sYN6YQ/h3/h001.tkWkaBW8GBBVPPndbtsuAu_izsk2d1chR6C7bpZOQiU) I keep coming back to how easy Keith Self has it. He gives his racist speeches from the House floor, where the rules protect him from anybody talking back. He posts his garbage about immigrants from behind a screen. He has spent years whipping up the fear that put Daniel in that cell, and he will never have to sit across a breakfast table and listen to what it did to two young people who did everything their government asked of them. **But men like Keith Self make sure they never have to. The cowardice is the whole design.** I served this country for 20 years, and I did it believing we were the good guys. Most days I still believe it. But there is nothing good about what our government did to this family, and I am not willing to shrug at it and move on. Neither are the folks of all political stripes I meet every day in this district. [**In November we can put somebody in that seat who looks families in the eye before casting votes that decide their lives. Chip in today and help us get there.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqs6gc2C5hUDUAX_oNaSPVDobFeqfVfzIW2x4J26hzyt88vYjUpFJYaGZm6wqGRF5E21KWmsNv2Dns9d_liBZCImhu6mWLMEP8R3ZbvHPIDP592ANxSh_6hr-Alc9NLPHgMO_Ns8TufikRtlx1v3sMPsLe5nFgDKuF0V1mlfFJWhvAm-tIlzl16oP8XkLdF4z1ID-UXL1VgnQDDCV7djUYp_Bg0WYtHwtD8oWzjck7N82NaVH2Ri-tF34WZkzA76UKNaJAi-YR73-Q59zVTP5wy9e7nwDFq7y5fgQDY1XYRrIKHqCyzEMY0MLeUJevUktWX_hOm87G3sXu9HDlqezGJ6nibe_vIDSA6PAqjX6Vupuc8nPkdd2lczZMSEONrsIZ6-LTu-IiPsD7WOstwIzRfkdpZvQyAg9RKoSGJRWBKZu3QwA2AnNmnb_Fpp5BKAMiyV8uYV_VYnRXaQFnaiSfBq/4ta/fRu1td85QCun07a7sYN6YQ/h4/h001.zqGALruJNq_PpDqEZs1k3d-NG-nrVsCTcJ9vJIeOXtw) Very respectfully, Evan Hunt Democratic Nominee TX-03

clean_body: All thanks to Keith Self. | | Peter, I had breakfast this week with a young woman who was brave enough to tell me what happened to her family. I will call her Sarah and her husband Daniel, to protect their privacy. | Daniel's parents brought him here from Mexico when he was 11. He grew up in Texas, worked his tail off, and it showed. He graduated valedictorian, earned two degrees from SMU, went on to advanced training in AI, and volunteered around his community the whole way through. He never had any criminal record at all. Last August he got pulled over in a minor traffic stop, and ICE took him. Sarah is an American citizen who was in law school at the time. And while she fought for Daniel, government lawyers dug up her old dating history and brought it up in the proceedings. Think about that lunacy for a second. Her own government went after her personal life because she stood by her husband. The two of them got married inside the detention center, and when his lawyer told him an appeal meant many more months locked up with no guarantee at the end, Daniel gave up and left for Mexico. Sarah dropped out of law school after that. She told me she went into law because she wanted to help people, and after what she watched it do to Daniel, she could not stomach it anymore. Now she is leaving the country she was born in to be with her husband. I keep coming back to how easy Keith Self has it. He gives his racist speeches from the House floor, where the rules protect him from anybody talking back. He posts his garbage about immigrants from behind a screen. He has spent years whipping up the fear that put Daniel in that cell, and he will never have to sit across a breakfast table and listen to what it did to two young people who did everything their government asked of them. But men like Keith Self make sure they never have to. The cowardice is the whole design. I served this country for 20 years, and I did it believing we were the good guys. Most days I still believe it. But there is nothing good about what our government did to this family, and I am not willing to shrug at it and move on. Neither are the folks of all political stripes I meet every day in this district. Let me explain.
Nevada's Public Utility Commissioners aren't elected. The governor appoints them, and Lombardo's commissioners just approved a new "peak demand charge," raising rates for Nevada families.

* NV Energy has poured tens of thousands of dollars into Lombardo's campaign.

What began as an investigation into a shooting in Baltimore has grown into a superseding indictment for drug trafficking, conspiracy, and money laundering that now includes at least two Chinese nationals with ties to cannabis cartels operating in Maine.
Zebin Liu, a Chinese national who held a Maine medical-cannabis caregiver license and operated a Gardiner grow under the name Liu Garden LLC, is a charged defendant in a 17-person Maryland marijuana-distribution and money-laundering case, according to court records reviewed by the Maine Wire.
The case -- _U.S. v. Tao_ -- is one of two high-profile federal indictments for money laundering and conspiracy tied to Maine's sprawling network of Chinese cannabis grows.

Last year, seven Chinese nationals were indicted in the District of Massachusetts on similar charges: trafficking illicit cannabis out of Maine and laundering the proceeds.
In Maryland, prosecutors say Can Quan Xu, who went by "Shawn," ran the New York hub that took Maryland drug cash, laundered it or moved it, and then paid the supply chain of growers and traffickers.
Federal agents arrested Liu, also known as Ben, on Staten Island on Sept. 24, 2024 on suspicions that he worked directly for Xu as part of the drug trafficking and money laundering conspiracy. Court records say he was paid to receive shipments, package and distribute marijuana, and move bulk cash.
The complaint says Liu referred to Can Xu as his "boss."
The arrest-warrant filed that day in Brooklyn federal court lists Liu's last known residence of 19 Abby Lane, Whitefield, ME.
Months earlier, at the same Whitefield property, the Lincoln County Sheriffs Department had arrested Wan Ting Xiao, 50, of San Gabriel, Calif., and Ding Zhan Liao, 49, of Brooklyn, N.Y.
Liu and Xu, along with Huayi Zhong, Isaac Huynh, and Chunbing Qin, were detained in Brooklyn for removal to Maryland. The detention letter says the men are Chinese citizens arrested on District of Maryland warrants charging conspiracy to distribute controlled substances, conspiracy to launder money, or both.
What's not contained in the Maryland court record is Zebin Liu's extensive connections to illicit cannabis grows in Maine -- or the fact that Can Quan Xu is the brother of Tianquan Xu, a cannabis growing partner to Liu with ongoing cannabis operations in Maine.
## **Maine Cannabis to Maryland Money Laundering**
The U.S. Attorney's Office for the District of Maryland has said the case started with drug-related shootings in Baltimore before growing into a Chinese money-laundering investigation centered in New York City.
A Maryland grand jury returned a superseding indictment on Oct. 9, 2024, naming Can Quan Xu and Zebin Liu among 17 defendants.
Prosecutors cited seizures of more than $6 million and more than 2,000 pounds of marijuana.
Can Xu is the brother of Tianquan Xu, and the pair have shared a Staten Island address, as well as an interest in Maine-grown cannabis. Tianquan, who goes by "Eric" in Maine, is not mentioned in the court documents and has not been charged with any crime.
Xu and Liu's case is ongoing in Maryland.
[Share The Robinson Report](https://substack..CbSwikSUAPixuFo_CHb5kHyrNuWW8iG72zqm4hUtbVY?)
According to OCP records, Zebin Liu worked with Tianquan Xu at the Gardiner cannabis facility in the months before he was arrested on conspiracy charges in Maryland.
Just days after the Whitefield property described in court records as Liu's last known address was raided by Maine sheriffs, Liu and Xu met OCP inspectors in Gardiner, according to inspection records obtained under the Freedom of Access Act.
The records show that Xu and Liu both operated cannabis cultivation sites at 333 Brunswick Ave. in Gardiner, the old Maine National Guard building: Indoor Sunrise and Liu Garden.
Although the details of the Maryland case suggest that the end customers for the cannabis grown throughout Maine were located outside of Maine, there is plenty of evidence to suggest Mainers have been buying and consuming the product.
OCP inspection records show Liu and Xu both reported selling "100% wholesale" to Dontae J. Jones, a registered medical-cannabis caregiver and the owner of Klouds Society, a Winslow retailer. The product-packaging notation read: "100% wholesales to Dontae J. Jones (CGR30324) Brownville, Maine."
Two years later, OCP issued a public advisory concerning vape products sold by Klouds Society in Winslow, an operation controlled, at least on paper, by Jones. The agency said vapes purchased outside Maine's legal medical-cannabis program tested positive for unsafe levels of bifenthrin, chlorfenapyr, cypermethrin, malathion and permethrin.
That pesticide foot-print is the calling card of illicit cannabis grows, and Maine law enforcement have recovered evidence of fumigant use involving those toxins at multiple Chinese cannabis sites.
## **The China Connection**
Zebin Liu, Can Quan Xu, and Tianquan Xu's connections to cannabis sites in Maine sprawls even further.
Tianquan Xu used a Maine driver's license listing 110 Palm St. in Bangor as his home address when applying for permission to operate Indoor Sunrise LLC, 333 Brunswick Ave. in Gardiner. In a later application for Indoor Sunrise, Xu used a Maine driver's license with the address 1347 Moosehead Trail in Plymouth, a property owned by Hang S. Tse.
Tse currently controls Green Cana LLC, a cannabis business licensed in Plymouth at the same address as KKJ8 Farm, run by Crystal Zhao, Green Eternity, 1348 Leaf
All three of Xu's addresses -- 110 Palm St. in Bangor, 333 Brunswick Ave. in Gardiner, and 1347 Moosehead Trail in Plymouth -- are listed by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security as properties with suspected connections to transnational criminal organizations, according to a copy of that list obtained by The Maine Wire.
The same Bangor address -- 110 Palm St. -- appears in Kennebec County property-tax records for Aibao Chen, the wife of Xisen Guo, listed as her mailing address. When Guo was arrested in Passadumkeag for illicit cannabis trafficking, investigators recovered evidence linking him to that cannabis growing operation in Sidney at a home owned by Chen.
Liu is listed as the contact for the 400-amp electrical service permit obtained for an illicit cannabis grow at 336 Zions Hill Rd. in Dexter, a property owned by Jessie He. That property was the subject of a March 2025 search warrant targeting Larry Zhao and Wen Hui Li as part of a drug-trafficking and money laundering probe. According to the search warrant affidavit Zebin Liu was on the Central Maine Power account for several months, along with Liu Zhen and Yiming He.
Zhiheng Chen, who was an unlicensed assistant to both Xu and Liu in Gardiner, not operates Zhiheng Garden LLC, a cannabis grow with operations in Etna.

The names and addresses all start to run together, but that's the point.
Public records show a recurring pattern: Licensed caregivers, unlicensed grow sites, real-estate holding companies, electrical upgrades capable of supporting large indoor cultivation operations, and overlapping names and addresses -- all managed by Chinese nationals who came to Maine by way of Massachusetts or New York.
The records point to cooperation and organization among these cannabis sites, their financiers, and their operators -- what OCP officials and federal prosecutors have referred to, for non-Chinese cannabis business owners, as a prohibited collective.

Aug 18 | | | | | | | | | | | | | ---|---|--- What began as an investigation into a shooting in Baltimore has grown into a superseding indictment for drug trafficking, conspiracy, and money laundering that now includes at least two Chinese nationals with ties to cannabis cartels operating in Maine. Zebin Liu, a Chinese national who held a Maine medical-cannabis caregiver license and operated a Gardiner grow under the name Liu Garden LLC, is a charged defendant in a 17-person Maryland marijuana-distribution and money-laundering case, according to court records reviewed by the Maine Wire. The case -- U.S. v. Tao -- is one of two high-profile federal indictments for money laundering and conspiracy tied to Maine's sprawling network of Chinese cannabis grows. This Substack is reader-supported. To receive new posts and support my work, consider becoming a free or paid subscriber. Last year, seven Chinese nationals were indicted in the District of Massachusetts on similar charges: trafficking illicit cannabis out of Maine and laundering the proceeds. In Maryland, prosecutors say Can Quan Xu, who went by "Shawn," ran the New York hub that took Maryland drug cash, laundered it or moved it, and then paid the supply chain of growers and traffickers. Federal agents arrested Liu, also known as Ben, on Staten Island on Sept. 24, 2024 on suspicions that he worked directly for Xu as part of the drug trafficking and money laundering conspiracy. Court records say he was paid to receive shipments, package and distribute marijuana, and move bulk cash. The complaint says Liu referred to Can Xu as his "boss." The arrest-warrant filed that day in Brooklyn federal court lists Liu's last known residence of 19 Abby Lane, Whitefield, ME. Months earlier, at the same Whitefield property, the Lincoln County Sheriffs Department had arrested Wan Ting Xiao, 50, of San Gabriel, Calif., and Ding Zhan Liao, 49, of Brooklyn, N.Y. Liu and Xu, along with Huayi Zhong, Isaac Huynh, and Chunbing Qin, were detained in Brooklyn for removal to Maryland. The detention letter says the men are Chinese citizens arrested on District of Maryland warrants charging conspiracy to distribute controlled substances, conspiracy to launder money, or both. What's not contained in the Maryland court record is Zebin Liu's extensive connections to illicit cannabis grows in Maine -- or the fact that Can Quan Xu is the brother of Tianquan Xu, a cannabis growing partner to Liu with ongoing cannabis operations in Maine. Maine Cannabis to Maryland Money Laundering The U.S. Attorney's Office for the District of Maryland has said the case started with drug-related shootings in Baltimore before growing into a Chinese money-laundering investigation centered in New York City. A Maryland grand jury returned a superseding indictment on Oct. 9, 2024, naming Can Quan Xu and Zebin Liu among 17 defendants. Prosecutors cited seizures of more than $6 million and more than 2,000 pounds of marijuana. Can Xu is the brother of Tianquan Xu, and the pair have shared a Staten Island address, as well as an interest in Maine-grown cannabis. Tianquan, who goes by "Eric" in Maine, is not mentioned in the court documents and has not been charged with any crime. Xu and Liu's case is ongoing in Maryland. ? According to OCP records, Zebin Liu worked with Tianquan Xu at the Gardiner cannabis facility in the months before he was arrested on conspiracy charges in Maryland. Just days after the Whitefield property described in court records as Liu's last known address was raided by Maine sheriffs, Liu and Xu met OCP inspectors in Gardiner, according to inspection records obtained under the Freedom of Access Act. The records show that Xu and Liu both operated cannabis cultivation sites at 333 Brunswick Ave. in Gardiner, the old Maine National Guard building: Indoor Sunrise and Liu Garden. Although the details of the Maryland case suggest that the end customers for the cannabis grown throughout Maine were located outside of Maine, there is plenty of evidence to suggest Mainers have been buying and consuming the product. OCP inspection records show Liu and Xu both reported selling "100% wholesale" to Dontae J. Jones, a registered medical-cannabis caregiver and the owner of Klouds Society, a Winslow retailer. The product-packaging notation read: "100% wholesales to Dontae J. Jones (CGR30324) Brownville, Maine." Two years later, OCP issued a public advisory concerning vape products sold by Klouds Society in Winslow, an operation controlled, at least on paper, by Jones. The agency said vapes purchased outside Maine's legal medical-cannabis program tested positive for unsafe levels of bifenthrin, chlorfenapyr, cypermethrin, malathion and permethrin. That pesticide foot-print is the calling card of illicit cannabis grows, and Maine law enforcement have recovered evidence of fumigant use involving those toxins at multiple Chinese cannabis sites. The China Connection Zebin Liu, Can Quan Xu, and Tianquan Xu's connections to cannabis sites in Maine sprawls even further. Tianquan Xu used a Maine driver's license listing 110 Palm St. in Bangor as his home address when applying for permission to operate Indoor Sunrise LLC, 333 Brunswick Ave. in Gardiner. In a later application for Indoor Sunrise, Xu used a Maine driver's license with the address 1347 Moosehead Trail in Plymouth, a property owned by Hang S. Tse. Tse currently controls Green Cana LLC, a cannabis business licensed in Plymouth at the same address as KKJ8 Farm, run by Crystal Zhao, Green Eternity, 1348 Leaf All three of Xu's addresses -- 110 Palm St. in Bangor, 333 Brunswick Ave. in Gardiner, and 1347 Moosehead Trail in Plymouth -- are listed by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security as properties with suspected connections to transnational criminal organizations, according to a copy of that list obtained by The Maine Wire. The same Bangor address -- 110 Palm St. -- appears in Kennebec County property-tax records for Aibao Chen, the wife of Xisen Guo, listed as her mailing address. When Guo was arrested in Passadumkeag for illicit cannabis trafficking, investigators recovered evidence linking him to that cannabis growing operation in Sidney at a home owned by Chen. Liu is listed as the contact for the 400-amp electrical service permit obtained for an illicit cannabis grow at 336 Zions Hill Rd. in Dexter, a property owned by Jessie He. That property was the subject of a March 2025 search warrant targeting Larry Zhao and Wen Hui Li as part of a drug-trafficking and money laundering probe. According to the search warrant affidavit Zebin Liu was on the Central Maine Power account for several months, along with Liu Zhen and Yiming He. Zhiheng Chen, who was an unlicensed assistant to both Xu and Liu in Gardiner, not operates Zhiheng Garden LLC, a cannabis grow with operations in Etna. The names and addresses all start to run together, but that's the point. Public records show a recurring pattern: Licensed caregivers, unlicensed grow sites, real-estate holding companies, electrical upgrades capable of supporting large indoor cultivation operations, and overlapping names and addresses -- all managed by Chinese nationals who came to Maine by way of Massachusetts or New York. The records point to cooperation and organization among these cannabis sites, their financiers, and their operators -- what OCP officials and federal prosecutors have referred to, for non-Chinese cannabis business owners, as a prohibited collective. | Friends,

**Today is Primary Election Day — and I'm asking you to stand with me.**

Freedom itself is on the ballot. Right now, millions of dollars in dark money are pouring into our state from outside groups who think they know better than Alaskans about how we should live, work, and raise our families. The radical socialist agenda being pushed on us from the Lower 48 threatens everything that makes Alaska exceptional — our resource economy, our Second Amendment rights, our independence, and our way of life.

**They have the money. But we have something they can't buy: Alaskans who show up.**

That's why your vote today matters so much. Every single ballot cast is a message that Alaska is not for sale, not to coastal elites, not to dark money super PACs, and not to anyone who wants to turn our state into something it was never meant to be.

**Polls are open until 8:00 PM tonight. If you haven't voted yet, please make a plan right now:**

Find your polling place and cast your ballot. Then call a friend, a neighbor, or a family member and make sure they do the same. Elections in Alaska are won by the people who show up and this is our time to show the country Alaska is unlocked and will stay that way.

I'm honored to fight for you in Washington, and I'm asking for your vote today so we can keep fighting for our jobs, our families, our freedoms, and our future.

For Alaska,

Nick Begich

_P.S. Turnout decides everything today. If you've already voted — thank you. Now forward this email to three fellow Alaskans and remind them: polls close at 8:00 PM. Freedom is on the ballot. Let's win this._

Peter,

North Carolina GOP state supreme court nominee Sarah Stevens has been named as an attendee at a fundraiser hosted by a man named Harvey West, a MAGA operative and convicted child sex offender.
According to reporting by the Asheville Watchdog, when Harvey West was a 28-year-old police officer, he was arrested and charged with the statutory rape of three girls, two aged 14 and one aged 16.
West pled guilty to 16 lesser charges of "taking indecent liberties with a child" and served six years in prison.
In 2018 after North Carolina began partisan elections for judges, West founded his annual "North Carolina Judicial Picnic" that has drawn many of the state's most prominent Republicans to his home for a fundraiser, including GOP US Senate nominee Michael Whatley -- and GOP State Supreme Court nominee Sarah Stevens.
---

Even fellow conservatives have publicly condemned GOP candidates' participation in West's fundraisers. One Republican activist said: "Sarah Stevens, I guarantee you, today is regretting that she attended that picnic...It's going to cost her her election. She will lose to Anita Earls."
People who have made mistakes and served their time certainly deserve second chances. But associating with sex offenders, particularly those implicated in serious and disturbing crimes involving children as young as 14, calls into question the judgment of candidates for public office -- ESPECIALLY a candidate running to serve on the state's highest court.
Sarah Stevens is not fit to rule on the NC Supreme Court. We have to rally and throw everything we've got into re-electing and retaining Justice Anita Earls, a woman of integrity and principles who has already proven herself to be a fair and competent judge.
As a bonus, if Justice Earls wins and retains her seat this year then three GOP justices will be on the ballot in 2028, giving Democrats a golden opportunity to flip control of this court entirely in a single election. But we have to win in November first.

Every time of revival is powerful, but what happened in Virginia Beach this weekend is something I'll never forget for the rest of my life.

Virginia Beach is close to my heart. It's where the Lord stirred in my heart in high school, where I spent time at the beach and in the water, and Saturday night, on my birthday, dozens of people surrendered their lives to Jesus on the beach, and were baptized in the ocean in the dark!

It's hard to put into words what we witnessed, but this feels like revival history unfolding before our very eyes.

clean_body: | | | | | Every time of revival is powerful, but what happened in Virginia Beach this weekend is something I'll never forget for the rest of my life. Virginia Beach is close to my heart. It's where the Lord stirred in my heart in high school, where I spent time at the beach and in the water, and Saturday night, on my birthday, dozens of people surrendered their lives to Jesus on the beach, and were baptized in the ocean in the dark! It's hard to put into words what we witnessed, but this feels like revival history unfolding before our very eyes. People have been trying to write off Let Us Worship from the beginning. But the detractors were bound to be wrong, because what we are doing is a God-calling, and that calling isn't over. God is just getting started and He is still moving in power all across this nation and beyond. # Fun Fact of the Month
---
Redwood sorrel doesn't mess around when it comes to the sun. This shade-loving plant can’t exactly lather on sunscreen, so its leaflets fold downward to avoid getting scorched. What looks like wilting is a clever movement, akin to a Venus flytrap closing.Discover more **[surprising tricks](https://click.everyaction.com/k/137474116/640902667/1854084929?sourceid=1170895&utm_campaign=redwoodmatters&utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-redwoodmatters&utm_term=rm-08-2026&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImJiZjFjMDQ0LTM5OWItZjExMS05YjMzLTAwMGQzYTExZmEzMCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=z0JTBVZsozwGYJkI_IBOPnvV6dgiIy_rh51qjPZHf2Y=&emci=0f8107c4-6097-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&emdi=bbf1c044-399b-f111-9b33-000d3a11fa30&ceid=1504551)** plants use to thrive.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: Pounding the pavement and putting on the mileage
body:
Now that we’re less than 80 days out from the election, we can’t pump the brakes anytime soon.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1134&source=&t=1&akid=2795%2E124072%2EkDrmLo)
| | | |
---
I’ve been running around the state, Peter – and I'm so full of gratitude.
We’ve spent the summer criss-crossing North Carolina on the Make Stuff Cost Less campaign tour – from Graham to Wilson to Asheville and more stops along the way.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1134&amount=5&t=8&akid=2795%2E124072%2EkDrmLo) | [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1134&amount=5&t=9&akid=2795%2E124072%2EkDrmLo)
---|---
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1134&amount=5&t=10&akid=2795%2E124072%2EkDrmLo) | [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1134&amount=5&t=11&akid=2795%2E124072%2EkDrmLo)
We’re pounding the pavement and putting on the mileage because winning this battleground Senate race means reaching every voter we can across the state.
**Now that we’re less than 80 days out from the election, we can’t pump the brakes anytime soon – but all this traveling comes with a hefty price tag. We need to raise an extra $25,000 by midnight to fuel next month’s leg of the tour, so I have to ask:[_Can you please chip in $5 today to help us keep campaigning across the Tar Heel state?_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1134&amount=5&t=12&akid=2795%2E124072%2EkDrmLo)**
| | [DONATE](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1134&amount=5&t=13&akid=2795%2E124072%2EkDrmLo)
---
While talking with North Carolinians face-to-face, I keep hearing versions of the same thing at every stop:
🚨 Basic necessities like groceries and gas are unaffordable for many.

🏠 Buying a house seems impossible, especially for younger people.

🇺🇲 There are those who believe the American Dream feels unattainable.
In short: **Stuff costs too much, and politicians in Washington DC don't seem to care.**
When I hear that, I know it’s time to get to work – because we can do so much better. This campaign is about making sure voters know exactly what I plan to do as their next U.S. Senator.
**I’m in this fight to put people before power, party and politics** – just as I did over my eight years as Governor, by expanding Medicaid for hundreds of thousands of working North Carolinians, adding good-paying jobs, increasing teacher pay, expanding paid parental leave and more.
**Now, I’m ready to keep up the fight in the U.S. Senate – but getting there won’t be easy. The GOP is flooding the airwaves with false attacks, so we need to keep showing up across North Carolina and winning folks onto our side.** That said, staying on the road like this takes money (gas, materials, organizers), and our budgeting deadline is just hours away.
[**_Every dollar we get toward our Make Stuff Cost Less tour goal will keep us on the road and meeting the voters who will decide this race – so Peter, if you’re able, will you chip in $5 now, or anything you can to help us get there before the end of the day?_**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1134&amount=5&t=14&akid=2795%2E124072%2EkDrmLo)
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1134&amount=5&t=15&akid=2795%2E124072%2EkDrmLo)
---
| | [DONATE $25](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1134&amount=25&t=16&akid=2795%2E124072%2EkDrmLo)
---
| | [DONATE $50](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1134&amount=50&t=17&akid=2795%2E124072%2EkDrmLo)
---
| | [OTHER AMOUNT](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1134&t=18&akid=2795%2E124072%2EkDrmLo)
---
Thanks for all you do,

Roy Cooper
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1134&t=2&akid=2795%2E124072%2EkDrmLo)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

[**_Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1134&source=&t=3&akid=2795%2E124072%2EkDrmLo)
| | [DONATE](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1134&source=&t=4&akid=2795%2E124072%2EkDrmLo)

And we need your help to reach early voters now! DEAR FRIENDS,

What a night we had on Saturday.

The 2nd Rhode Island First Rally at the Cranston Park Theater was packed with energy, patriotism, and real Rhode Island spirit.
Standing on that stage with Rudy Giuliani — America's Mayor — was an honor. Rudy has officially endorsed our campaign, and that
means a lot. He knows what strong leadership looks like, and he's putting his support behind putting Rhode Island first.

We also received a powerful endorsement from Cranston Mayor Ken Hopkins. Having the support of a mayor who actually delivers for
his city strengthens the message that this campaign is about results, not empty talk.

The energy in that room was electric. Rhode Islanders showed up ready to fight for jobs, safer communities, lower costs, and a
future where our young people don't have to leave the state to find opportunity. This is what the Rhode Island First movement
looks like in action.

Now the real work begins. The Republican Primary is on September 9, and this is crunch time.

clean_body: [] [] DEAR FRIENDS, What a night we had on Saturday. The 2nd Rhode Island First Rally at the Cranston Park Theater was packed with energy, patriotism, and real Rhode Island spirit. Standing on that stage with Rudy Giuliani — America's Mayor — was an honor. Rudy has officially endorsed our campaign, and that means a lot. He knows what strong leadership looks like, and he's putting his support behind putting Rhode Island first. We also received a powerful endorsement from Cranston Mayor Ken Hopkins. Having the support of a mayor who actually delivers for his city strengthens the message that this campaign is about results, not empty talk. The energy in that room was electric. Rhode Islanders showed up ready to fight for jobs, safer communities, lower costs, and a future where our young people don't have to leave the state to find opportunity. This is what the Rhode Island First movement looks like in action. Now the real work begins. The Republican Primary is on September 9, and this is crunch time. If you or someone you know needs a ride to the polls, we are ready to help. Visit the website at vicmellor.com [] or call 401-545-0127. We also need volunteers. Sign up for volunteer training on the website today. Every door knocked, every call made, and every ride given makes a difference. This race will be won by the people who show up and do the work. I am all in. I need you with me. Thank you for standing with me. Sincerely, Vic Mellor Candidate for Congress, Rhode Island's 2nd District [] [] [] [] [] [] [] Want to change how you receive these emails?

subject: AI is “as toxic as AIPAC”
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JUSTICE DEMOCRATS
body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

As Big Tech becomes an even bigger spender in our elections, Justice
Democrats has been sounding the alarm: the artificial intelligence (AI)
industry is poised to become the new AIPAC.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260818.ytAI3s&refcode=em20260818-38175&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=38175%2E1203867%2EmnBNTi ]MS NOW: ‘As toxic as AIPAC’: Progressive leader wants Dems to reject AI
cash. Rep. Greg Casar, D-Texas, is imploring his Democratic colleagues not
to take campaign donations from the artificial intelligence industry and
to get serious about regulating AI.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260818.ytAI3s&refcode=em20260818-38175&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1003&akid=38175%2E1203867%2EmnBNTi ]Before we say more, if you’re ready to stand with us against AI super
PACs and Big Tech billionaires, rush a grassroots contribution now →

For decades, establishment Democrats have sided with the pro-Israel lobby,
falling in line to fund the genocide of Palestinians. They’ve sold out to
AIPAC and their network of deep-pocketed donors and super PACs to secure
their political careers. But AIPAC has become increasingly toxic as the
majority of Democratic voters oppose funding Israel.

Now, we’re watching a familiar playbook repeat itself. This cycle, AI
super PACs have already spent almost $55 million on the midterm elections,
including $3.5 million in Illinois and $1.6 million in North Carolina to
defeat JD primary candidates.

Leading the Future, a massive pro-AI super PAC, has already raised over
$76.5 million this cycle to back candidates on both sides of the aisle who
will vote against regulation. But as more members of the Democratic
establishment cash these checks, they’re moving further out of step with
voters.

As Justice Democrats Rep. Greg Casar pointed out, over 75 percent of
Americans want sensible AI regulation to prevent mass unemployment,
surveillance, and national security risks. Plus, we’re seeing
working-class communities across the country organizing against toxic data
centers that pollute our air and water.

Greg predicts that in 2028, AI figureheads like Sam Altman will be “as big
a villain to Democrats as Elon Musk is today,” and that “big anti-AI
regulation donors” like Leading the Future will be “as toxic as AIPAC.”

If Democrats want to win voters over, Greg says they should reject
campaign contributions from the pro-AI lobby — and he’s right.

Time and again, too many Do-Nothing Democrats have joined Republicans in
siding with corporate donors over working people, sowing distrust in the
Party.

That’s why our candidates reject all corporate PAC money and stay
accountable to the people they’re meant to serve.

Justice Democrats refuse to be bought by Big Tech billionaires. Instead,
they depend on grassroots contributions from everyday people like you to
power their campaigns to victory.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260818.ytAI3s&refcode=em20260818-38175&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1004&akid=38175%2E1203867%2EmnBNTi ]Help us continue to take on the AI lobby and stop them from buying more
influence in Congress: chip in $5 or whatever you can to
support our progressive candidates ahead of November’s midterms.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260818.ytAI3s&refcode=em20260818-38175&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1023&akid=38175%2E1203867%2EmnBNTi ]Contribute $5

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

Here is what I talk about in this week's episode and a free preview:
[](https://substack.com/redirect/16ea2598-8fa6-456b-ab5f-29973446773f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
On Friday, Donald Trump was up in New York campaigning. Not for himself, but does he ever really do anything that's not for himself? He was in Nassau County stumping for his longtime friend Bruce Blakeman, trying to help him unseat Governor Kathy Hochul. Nothing new there. The man is a walking Hatch Act violation.
What caught my attention wasn't the rally. It was the backdrop.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/12647958-6afa-45be-84be-91fe088ee351?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Row after row of law enforcement officers standing behind him. Clapping. Hanging on every word, including when he bragged that "we killed DEI" and then gestured at the officers behind him like props. "I don't see the people behind me big on DEI. That's not a DEI group, I can tell."
Kind of ironic, considering the number of women and Latino officers standing right there behind him.
I wore that uniform for over 15 years. I believe policing is one of the most noble professions there is, when you do it for the people and not for a power kick. Protect and serve. That's the job description. So watching officers stand there and cheer for the man who fomented the mob that beat and sprayed and stabbed my coworkers on January 6th, the man who pardoned the people who assaulted us and now wants to pay them?
It's an absolute disgrace.
In this week's episode of Standing Our Ground, I get into all of it. Why the Fraternal Order of Police endorsing Donald Trump three times is a betrayal of every officer who bled on January 6th, and why I turned in my own FOP membership. A story about the FOP and a January 6th rioter that I lived through and still can't believe. And a self-proclaimed "proud J6 patriot" who has loaned himself millions of dollars to try to buy a seat in Congress, with Rudy Giuliani and Mike Flynn campaigning at his side. I'm naming him. I'm telling you exactly what he said about January 6th. And I'm telling you what I plan to do about it.

---
| | | | | | PRESS RELEASE
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEAugust 18, 2026

## **OLLIVANT COMMITS TO KEY CANDIDATE FORUMS AND DEBATES - CONDITIONAL ON FULL FIELD PARTICIPATION**
**CULPEPER COUNTY, VA** — Doug Ollivant, Republican nominee for Virginia’s 7th Congressional District, today announced he will participate in the following candidate forums and debates, provided that Democrat Yevgeny “Eugene” Vindman and independent candidate Alaha Ahrar are both formally invited and accept those invitations:
* Prince William Committee of 100 and the Prince William & Fauquier Area League of Women Voters Candidate Forum: Thursday, September 10, 2026

* University of Mary Washington Candidate Debate: Date TBD

* Arc of Northern Virginia and the Autism Society of Northern Virginia Candidate Forum: October 1, 2026

“I believe in free speech, and that means voters deserve a clear, side-by-side comparison of every serious candidate on the ballot,” Ollivant said. “I insist that all candidates for Virginia’s 7th Congressional District participate in any and all debates and forums. I will gladly stand on stage at these events and any in the future as long as Yevgeny Vindman and Alaha Ahrar are invited and accept. Anything less denies the people of the 7th District a full understanding of the choices before them in the 2026 midterm elections.”
Ollivant’s campaign has already reached out to the organizers of each event to confirm its willingness to participate under these conditions and to encourage the full slate of candidates to do the same.

**About Doug Ollivant**

[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260818_2.4--Hhh&refcode=em20260818-2&t=1&akid=8378%2E582294%2E_nF40s)
Friend, you deserve to know why Alaska’s primary election is so important.
Today is Primary Day, so in a moment, I’m going to ask you to make a contribution to help get out the vote in this final window while voters cast their ballots.
But first, let me explain why Alaska’s primary is special -- and why your support will make a big difference to my campaign.
Today is Primary Day in Alaska.
Alaska has an open primary, which means I’ll be on the ballot with every other candidate running for U.S. Senate -- including incumbent Senator Dan Sullivan.
This is our first chance to flex our grassroots power directly against the DC establishment at the ballot box, and you can bet that everyone will be watching to see where we fall.
And the truth is -- the moment Primary Day passes, the general election will start in full swing.
That means we need to be ready. We have to get out the vote to win big tonight, and then we have to hit the ground running in what will be the most competitive and consequential Senate race this year.
I’m going up against an opponent backed by billionaire donors who want to keep the rigged DC system that’s benefiting them in place, so I need a huge grassroots team to come together to show them we can do this.
If everyone reading this chipped in $5, $10, or $50, we’d be well on our way to raising what we need to win.
But unfortunately, not everyone is in a place to give. That’s why it’s all the more important that you do.
So please:
**[Split a $5 donation between Chris Pappas and my campaign before Alaska’s primary is over tonight. I’m counting on people like you who know how important this turning point is to help us win.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260818_2.4--Hhh&refcode=em20260818-2&t=2&akid=8378%2E582294%2E_nF40s)**

Mary

body:
This cash infusion could change the outcome of this race
Peter, it's Sherrod. Republicans are pummeling my campaign with $133 million worth of attacks.
I just huddled with my campaign manager, and one thing became clear: **We need today to be our strongest grassroots fundraising day of the campaign yet if we’re going to stay competitive.[If that's all you need to hear, please rush a donation split between me and Wes Moore.](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260818-2.Ltqd9g&refcode=em-20260818-2&t=1&akid=1777%2E1086043%2E27r1HM)**

**Another dark money Republican group announced they're funneling $28 MILLION into stopping our momentum._They're spending more in Ohio than anywhere else in the country._**
The GOP's cash infusion has changed the game overnight. So now, we need to respond.
**I promise I wouldn’t ask if it weren’t important. But this is as important as it gets.[Please split anything you can between me and Wes Moore to help me reach today’s fundraising target and flip this seat:](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20260818-2.Ltqd9g&refcode=em-20260818-2&t=3&akid=1777%2E1086043%2E27r1HM)**

body:
We power our communities and our country, not just through our labor but through our vision. | | | Peter, Last week, we marked 14 years since the first DACA applications were accepted on August 15, 2012 — a milestone made possible by the relentless organizing of immigrant youth. We were told protections like DACA could never happen. We organized, persisted, and proved otherwise. # **[Meta's kid privacy trial puts the infinite scroll on trial for its life](https://substack.com/redirect/de4c36e8-987e-4a87-8a9c-3b06bb779ad9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Listen up. Opening day in Oakland and Meta's already bleeding about 4% to the mid-$540s as 29 states come swinging for the jugular. Meta has real issues, first with the damages for its bad behavior, $200 billion is seen as a realistic tab for what they will have to pay for what they did --although if it hit the proposed $1.4 trillion it would vaporize the market cap of the company--but the real knife is what might happen afterwards: forced death of "infinite scroll" and the engagement algorithms that print the ad dollars funding Zuck's AI empire. This is the engagement engine on the witness stand.
* **Winners?** Shorts collecting on every headline, state AGs scoring political points and tobacco-style trophies, and any rival that already dialed back the "hook the kids and addict them" features while Meta rode the dopamine wave.
* **Losers?** Meta longs who bought the July AI monetization story, Zuckerberg if the damages gut Meta of the time and money it invested, and the ad machine that turns teen dopamine into the cash that funds everything else.
* **Next?** Six to eight weeks of pure headline trading. Options already price a $30/5% move through August and $55/10% through September. Settlement or partial product neutering looks likely; full state win torches the core model.

**This isn 't some sideshow.** The same AI firepower we cheered when bulls shoved the stock higher now sits on a foundation of contested kid data and addictive design. Street already hates profitless prosperity spend, add court-ordered product surgery and the multiple compresses hard. Watch the testimony. Weak hands will fold. Smart money waits for the forced reset or the settlement floor. Zuck is running out of friends, even in the Metaverse.

# **[Private credit strain hits decade highs as the credit cycle finally bites](https://substack.com/redirect/de4c36e8-987e-4a87-8a9c-3b06bb779ad9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
The Financial Times just confirmed the blood is real. Non-accruals at the 20 largest BDCs hit a median 2.8% of cost in Q2, levels last seen in the 2017 oil hangover. 2020-21 zero-rate vintage loans are choking. Higher rates are starving borrowers of cash for growth.
* **Winners?** Oaktree and every dry-powder operator who stayed defensive. They conserve capital now and lean into the volatility later. Distressed buyers who wait for the forced sales will feast.
* **Losers?** KKR, Blue Owl and Apollo MidCap vehicles already down 14-15%. FS KKR sitting on 7.1% troubled loans. Software PE sponsors handing keys to lenders. BDC retail holders priced for death.
* **Next?** More writedowns, redemption gates, and impairments. Contagion risk into PE-controlled insurers. The 2020-21 vintage keeps bleeding while new commitments dry up.

Greed stuffed $2-3 trillion into opaque private credit after the banks ran for cover. Now the hangover arrives on schedule. Higher rates and AI disruption to software books are the twin grinders. Smart capital sits tight, waits for the carcasses, then buys the paper at 40 cents. The cycle never skips a generation. Profit from the pain or get crushed by it.
